entries.source: The cannon is not in working order. Repair it the next time you make camp.
entries.translation: 火炮无法正常使用。下次扎营时修理它。
未保存的进度将会丢失！

entries.source: was Crippled because of Aim Low halving the movement next turn
entries.translation: 因“瞄准下盘”而残废，下回合移动力减半

entries.source: A cave entrance has been spotted nearby. Send an expedition member to search for metal ore. A higher Patrolling skill and your own Scouting will increase the potential boon of exploring caves. Beware that caves can be dangerous, and there’s a risk that the follower may sustain a light injury.
entries.translation: 附近发现了一个洞穴入口。派遣一名远征队成员前去搜寻金属矿石。更高的巡逻技能和你自身的侦察能力会提高探索洞穴可能获得的好处。小心，洞穴可能很危险，随行者也有可能受轻伤。

entries.source: The nearby waters are rich with fish. Send an expedition member to the coast, and they may bring back some extra meat for tomorrow. If successful, the amount of Meat gained will depend on the expedition member’s Hunting skill and your own Hunting.
entries.translation: 附近水域鱼类丰富。派一名远征队成员去海岸看看，也许能为明天带回一些额外肉类。如果成功，获得的肉类数量取决于该成员的狩猎技能和你自身的狩猎能力。

entries.source: The undergrowth is covered in herbs with medicinal applications. Send an expedition member to harvest them. The spoils of the foray depend on the follower’s Herbalism skill and your knowledge of Healing.
entries.translation: 草丛中长满了可入药的草药。派一名远征队成员去采集。此次出行的收获取决于随行者的草药学技能和你对治疗的了解。

entries.source: Natives have been known to bury their dead nearby. Send an expedition member to search the graves for valuable trinkets. A higher Patrolling skill and your own Scouting will increase the potential loot from grave robbing. This is dirty work, however, and it may hurt the morale of the expedition member assigned.
entries.translation: 据说附近的原住民会将死者埋葬在附近。派一名远征队成员去坟墓中搜寻有价值的小饰品。更高的巡逻技能和你自身的侦察能力会增加掘墓所得。不过这活儿很不体面，负责的远征队成员可能会因此士气受挫。

entries.source: Your cannon has been damaged in combat and cannot be used again until repaired. Assign an expedition member to restore the cannon to working order.
entries.translation: 你的火炮在战斗中受损，修好之前无法再次使用。指派一名远征队成员将火炮修复至正常状态。

entries.source: You’ve broken enough equipment in battle that you could scavenge it for usable parts. Assign an expedition member to put together a few new pieces of equipment from the broken items.
entries.translation: 你们在战斗中损坏了足够多的装备，可以从中拆取可用零件。指派一名远征队成员用这些破损物品拼装几件新装备。

entries.source: The death of an expedition member always hurts morale, no matter the circumstances. Dedicate one of your expedition members’ time to arranging a small memorial service, and some of the morale your surviving expedition members have lost will be restored.
entries.translation: 无论缘由如何，远征队成员的死亡总会打击士气。安排一名远征队成员抽出时间筹办一场小型追悼仪式，会恢复幸存成员失去的一些士气。

entries.source: Your expedition has finished charting a region of this strange new land. Assign an expedition member to consolidate the maps of this region and make the most use of your knowledge. This will double the experience you got from finding the related cairns.
entries.translation: 你们的远征队已完成对这片陌生新大陆某地区的测绘。指派一名远征队成员整理该地区的地图，充分利用你们掌握的知识。此举会使你们发现相关石冢所获得的经验翻倍。

entries.source: If a unit is standing near torches or other fire during night or interior battles, it will be easier to hit.
entries.translation: 夜间或室内战斗时，如果单位站在火把或其他火源附近，就更容易被击中。

entries.source: If you are having a hard time consider lowering the difficulty
entries.translation: 如果觉得难以应付，可以考虑调低难度。

entries.source: You can rotate the camera with Q and E (by default) or by dragging with the right mouse button.
entries.translation: 按 Q 和 E（默认键位）或按住鼠标右键拖动，可以旋转镜头。

entries.source: Flank enemies to deal more damage.
entries.translation: 从侧翼攻击敌人可造成更多伤害。

entries.source: Don’t forget that you can use Tactical Move to escape an enemy without provoking Attack of Opportunity.
entries.translation: 别忘了，你可以使用“战术移动”脱离敌人而不触发“借机攻击”。

entries.source: In combat, you can pan the camera with WASD (by default) or the cursor keys.
entries.translation: 战斗中，按 WASD（默认键位）或方向键可以平移镜头。

entries.source: The colour of your line of sight indicator for ranged attacks shows how clear your shot is – green is a clear shot, yellow indicates partial cover, and red means you have no shot.
entries.translation: 远程攻击的视线指示线颜色会显示射击路线是否通畅：绿色表示视线清晰，黄色表示有部分掩护，红色表示无法射击。

entries.source: You can see every unit’s endurance bar if you hold down the Highlight hotkey (Alt by default).
entries.translation: 按住高亮显示快捷键（默认为 Alt）即可查看所有单位的耐力条。

entries.source: Unused Meat spoils overnight. You can convert Meat to Rations each night by using the Preserve task during Camp Management.
entries.translation: 未使用的肉类会在夜间变质。每晚可在“营地管理”中使用“腌制”任务，将肉类制成口粮。

entries.source: The Scout is a high damage melee unit with great movement range, good for flanking and hit-and-run tactics.
entries.translation: 斥候是高伤害的近战单位，移动力范围很大，擅长侧翼攻击和打了就跑的战术。

entries.source: Soldiers have high defence and good melee attacks and are great for protecting your more fragile units.
entries.translation: 士兵防御力高，近战攻击出色，非常适合保护较脆弱的单位。

entries.source: Hunters are your best ranged units but very weak in melee combat.
entries.translation: 猎人是最出色的远程单位，但在近战战斗中非常弱。

entries.source: Doctors are your basic healers, capable of restoring a measure of Endurance to other units during combat, or (on higher levels) curing negative effects and even reviving incapacitated allies.
entries.translation: 医生是基础治疗单位，能在战斗中为其他单位恢复一定耐力；等级较高时，还能治愈负面效果，甚至让失去行动能力的盟友复苏。

entries.source: The Scholar is a support unit who excels at making other units better and whose ranged attacks automatically lower an enemy’s Defence for all allies for the rest of the turn (regardless of whether or not it hits).
entries.translation: 学者是支援单位，擅长强化其他单位；其远程攻击会自动降低一名敌人的防御，使所有盟友在本回合剩余时间内受益（无论是否命中）。

entries.source: When you’ve set a path for your expedition to travel along, pressing Space starts or stops your movement along that path.
entries.translation: 为远征队设定行进路线后，按空格键即可开始或停止沿该路线行进。

entries.source: When available, use the Preparation phase to select a good starting formation and to place traps and barricades.
entries.translation: 条件允许时，可在战前准备阶段选择合适的起始阵型，并布置陷阱和路障。

entries.source: Don’t forget to switch to a melee weapon when an enemy is next to your unit – making a ranged attack when a unit is in melee range provokes an Attack of Opportunity.
entries.translation: 敌人靠近你的单位时，别忘了切换到近战武器——单位处于近战范围内时发动远程攻击会触发借机攻击。

entries.source: Switching between a unit’s ranged and melee weapons (R by default) is a free action that you can do whenever you wish.
entries.translation: 单位在远程武器和近战武器之间切换（默认按 R）是免费行动，随时都可以切换。

entries.source: Auto-assigning tasks on the Camp Management screen is a convenience that does not necessarily give you the optimal outcome. Remember to double-check your tasks after using it!
entries.translation: 在“营地管理”界面自动分配任务虽然方便，但未必能带来最佳结果。使用后记得再次检查任务分配！

entries.source: Contextual events such as fishing are a great way to gain extra resources when you make camp.
entries.translation: 扎营时，钓鱼之类的情境事件是获取额外资源的好机会。

entries.source: Remember to spend some time exploring the world for optional quests and events that can give you more resources and experience points.
entries.translation: 记得花些时间探索世界，寻找可选任务和事件，它们能带来更多资源和经验值。

entries.source: High morale not only prevents your units from leaving you in a mutiny, it also improves their critical hit chance in combat.
entries.translation: 高昂的士气不仅能防止你的部队因兵变而离你而去，还能提高他们在战斗中的暴击率。

entries.source: You can set a path over a long distance by clicking on any icon on the world map. Then just press Space (by default) to get moving.
entries.translation: 在世界地图上点击任意图标，即可设定一条较长距离的路线。然后按空格键（默认键位）即可出发。

entries.source: You’re playing on Insane difficulty. If you were expecting loading screen hints, sorry: You’re on your own.
entries.translation: 你正在以疯狂难度游玩。如果你还指望加载画面提示，那很抱歉：接下来只能靠自己了。

entries.translation: 追踪并救回遭遇海难的远征队成员

entries.translation: 使用盾牌部分挡下了来袭攻击！

entries.source: Iron Man mode disables manual saving during the game. You will have to make do with a single autosave slot, which will force you to live with the consequences of your actions (and your failures). Enable at your own risk!
entries.translation: 铁人模式会禁用游戏中的手动存档。你只能使用一个自动存档位，因此必须承担自己行动（以及失败）的后果。启用风险自负！

entries.source: Enemies often incur Attacks of Opportunity and prioritise their targets poorly.
entries.translation: 敌人常会遭受借机攻击，而且选择目标的优先级较差。

entries.source: Enemies sometimes provoke Attacks of Opportunity and make suboptimal use of special abilities.
entries.translation: 敌人有时会触发借机攻击，也不善于使用特殊能力。

entries.source: Enemies are fairly proficient but still sometimes incur Attacks of Opportunity.
entries.translation: 敌人相当熟练，但有时仍会遭受借机攻击。

entries.source: Enemies are shrewd, rarely making mistakes and using their special abilities well.
entries.translation: 敌人狡猾，极少犯错，而且善于使用特殊能力。

entries.source: Enemies are relentless, using their special abilities effectively and never provoking Attacks of Opportunity.
entries.translation: 敌人坚韧不屈，能有效使用特殊能力，也绝不会触发借机攻击。

entries.source: Heavy injuries are unlikely and will never exceed severe.
entries.translation: 严重伤势不太可能发生，伤势也绝不会超过重伤。

entries.source: Injuries will be worse but will never exceed Critical.
entries.translation: 伤势会更严重，但绝不会达到致命程度。

entries.source: Heavy injuries are more likely and can become Fatal!
entries.translation: 严重伤势更容易发生，也可能致命！

entries.source: Lope de Aguirre (aka. El Loco) was a Spanish conqueror who rebelled against the Spanish crown and attempted to make himself the prince of Peru. Eventually he was captured and shot to death. If you select this setting, don’t come crying to us for help, you brought it on yourself!
entries.translation: 洛佩·德·阿吉雷（又名“疯子”）是一名西班牙征服者，他曾反叛西班牙王室，并企图自立为秘鲁王子。最终他被捕并遭枪决。若选择此设置，遇到困难可别哭着来找我们帮忙——这是你自找的！

entries.source: Hernán Cortés was the Spanish conqueror of Mexico, who allied himself with the Totonac and Tlaxcala and overthrew the Aztec Empire, destroying Tenochtitlan. If you pick this setting, you will face some major challenges, but you are likely to prevail in the end.
entries.translation: 埃尔南·科尔特斯是征服墨西哥的西班牙征服者。他与托托纳克人和特拉斯卡拉人结盟，推翻了阿兹特克帝国，并摧毁了特诺奇蒂特兰。选择此设置将面临重大挑战，但最终很可能取胜。

entries.source: Cristoforo Colombo was the Italian explorer who discovered the Americas. Though he suffered some setbacks, his expeditions were quite successful. If you pick this setting, you are most likely to be successful as well.
entries.translation: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布是一位发现美洲的意大利探险家。尽管遭遇过一些挫折，他的远征仍相当成功。选择此设置的话，你也很可能取得成功。

entries.source: Francisco Pizarro González was the Spanish conqueror who exploited the aftermath of a civil war to conquer the Incan Empire. Then he was betrayed and killed by his own people. If you select this setting, you will have a hard time, but it will only make your victory all the sweeter!
entries.translation: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗·冈萨雷斯是一名西班牙征服者，他利用内战后的局势征服了印加帝国。后来，他遭自己人背叛并杀害。选择此设置会让你举步维艰，但胜利也将因此更加甜美！

Personality traits determine which decisions and events will cause each follower to gain or lose Morale.
entries.translation: 性格特征决定了哪些决定和事件会使每名队员的士气提升或降低。

entries.source:
*Aggressive*
May gain morale when you engage an enemy in combat, but may lose morale if you pass up an opportunity to fight.
entries.translation:
*好斗*
与敌人交战时士气可能提升，但错过战斗机会时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Peaceful*
May gain morale when you manage to avoid combat, but may lose morale if you deliberately seek out battle.
entries.translation:
*和平*
成功避免战斗时士气可能提升，但主动寻求战斗时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Racist*
May lose morale if you recruit followers of another ethnicity, but may gain morale if you display racism.
entries.translation:
*种族主义*
招募其他族裔的队员时士气可能降低，但表现出种族主义时士气可能提升。

entries.source:
*Open-Minded*
May gain morale if you recruit followers of another ethnicity, but may lose morale if you display racism.
entries.translation:
*思想开放*
招募其他族裔的队员时士气可能提升，但表现出种族主义时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Greedy*
May gain morale if you gain new resources, but may in turn lose morale if you give up or lose resources.
entries.translation:
*贪婪*
获得新资源时士气可能提升，但放弃或失去资源时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Altruistic*
May gain morale if you give up your resources for a good cause, but may lose morale if you behave greedily.
entries.translation:
*利他*
为善举牺牲资源时士气可能提升，但行为贪婪时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Courageous*
May gain morale if you stand your ground against a superior force, but may lose morale if you retreat from a dangerous situation.
entries.translation:
*勇敢*
面对优势敌军坚守阵地时士气可能提升，但在危险情况下撤退时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Cautious*
May gain morale if you avoid dangerous situations, but may lose morale if you take unnecessary risks.
entries.translation:
*谨慎*
避开危险情况时士气可能提升，但承担不必要的风险时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Narcissistic*
May gain morale if chosen for a task or promoted to a higher rank, but may lose morale if passed over for promotion.
entries.translation:
*自恋*
被选去执行任务或晋升时士气可能提升，但错失晋升机会时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Proud*
Gains morale every time you win a battle, but loses morale if you are defeated or fail to accomplish your goals.
entries.translation:
*自负*
每次赢得战斗都会提升士气，但战败或未能达成目标时士气会降低。

entries.source:
*Pious*
May gain morale if you act in accordance with their faith, but may lose morale if you transgress against their religious creed.
entries.translation:
*虔诚*
遵循其信仰行事时士气可能提升，但违背其宗教教义时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Adventurous*
May gain morale every time you make a significant discovery, but may lose morale if you shy away from adventure.
entries.translation:
*爱冒险*
每次有重大发现时士气可能提升，但畏惧冒险时士气可能降低。

entries.source:
*Lovesick*
Is in love with another follower. Will gain morale if you promote their lover but lose morale if their lover dies.
entries.translation:
*相思*
爱上了另一名队员。晋升其恋人时士气会提升，但恋人死亡时士气会降低。

entries.source:
*Rivalrous*
Has developed a rivalry with another follower. Will lose morale if you promote their ribval but gain it if their rival dies.
entries.translation:
*好胜*
与另一名队员结下了竞争关系。晋升其对手时士气会降低，但对手死亡时士气会提升。

entries.source:
*Traumatised*
Has had their spirit broken due to a traumatic experience.
entries.translation:
*受创*
一次创伤经历令其精神崩溃。

entries.source:
*Treacherous*
Has demonstrated an disconcerting lack of loyalty to your leadership.
entries.translation:
*背信弃义*
其行为表明，对你的领导缺乏忠诚，令人不安。

entries.source:
*Married*
Will gain morale if you demonstrate fidelity but lose morale if you flirt with others.
entries.translation:
*已婚*
你忠贞不渝时士气会提升，但与他人调情时士气会降低。

entries.source: Weapon proficiencies determine which weapons the follower can be assigned in the Equipment tab.
entries.translation: 武器熟练度决定了可以为该队员配备哪些武器，可在装备页签中进行分配。

entries.source:
*Valuables*
A currency for trading or bribes.
entries.translation:
*贵重物品*
可用于交易或行贿的货币。

entries.source:
*Equipment*
Upgrades the weapons and armour of your troops.
entries.translation:
*装备*
用于升级部队的武器和护甲。

entries.source:
*Medicine*
Used to treat injured expedition members.
entries.translation:
*药品*
用于治疗受伤的远征队成员。

entries.source:
*Rations*
Feeds your expedition members when you make camp.
entries.translation:
*口粮*
扎营时为远征队成员提供食物。

*木材*
用于制作普通物品的材料。

*金属*
用于制作高级物品的材料。

*绳索*
用于制作大型物品的材料。

*油料*
用于制作易燃物品的材料。

entries.source: A currency for trading or bribes. When you return to Spain, your success is measured not only by what you've discovered, but also how many valuables you bring back with you.
entries.translation: 交易或行贿所用的货币。返回西班牙时，衡量远征成果的不仅是你发现了什么，还有带回了多少贵重物品。

entries.source: Your equipment determines how well armed and armoured your people are in combat. You assign equipment to your people in the Followers menu. Only unassigned equipment shows up here.
entries.translation: 你的装备决定了队员在战斗中的武装与防护程度。你可以在队员菜单中为他们分配装备。此处仅显示尚未分配的装备。

entries.source: When your expedition members are injured or fall sick, they will require medical treatment to get back on their feet. Herbs can be turned into medicine with the Herbalism task.
entries.translation: 远征队成员受伤或患病时，需要接受治疗才能恢复。草药可通过草药学任务制成药品。

entries.source: Each member of your expedition consumes 1 ration every time you make camp. Meat can be turned into rations with the Preserve task.
entries.translation: 远征队每名成员每次扎营消耗1份口粮。可通过分配队员执行腌制任务，将肉类制成口粮。

entries.source: Wood is a crafting material needed to construct most items.
entries.translation: 木材是制作大多数物品所需的材料。

entries.source: Metal from ore or salvaged equipment can be used to make advanced items.
entries.translation: 矿石或回收装备中的金属可用于制作高级物品。

entries.source: Rope is useful for building traps or larger items.
entries.translation: 绳索可用于制作陷阱或大型物品。

entries.source: Oil is needed to build flammable items.
entries.translation: 制作易燃物品需要油料。

entries.source: Meat from hunting can be turned into Rations by assigning your people to the Preserve task. Any meat that isn't preserved as soon as you make camp will spoil.
entries.translation: 狩猎获得的肉类可通过分配队员执行腌制任务制成口粮。每次扎营时，所有未及时腌制的肉类都会变质。

entries.source: Herbs that you've collected on your travels can be turned into Medicine by assigning people to the Herbalism task. Unlike meat, herbs don't spoil.
entries.translation: 旅途中采集的草药可通过分配队员执行草药学任务制成药品。草药不会像肉类那样变质。

entries.source:
*Tactics*
Used to change the starting situation in a battle to your advantage. Determines the amount of items you can bring into combat and how far from your troops you can place them.
entries.translation:
*战术*
用于在战斗开始前改变战局，使其对你有利。该技能决定可带入战斗的物品数量，以及这些物品可放置在离部队多远的位置。

entries.source:
*Diplomacy*
Affects your chances of success in negotiations and cultural exchanges.
entries.translation:
*外交*
影响谈判和文化交流的成功率。

entries.source:
*Healing*
Reduces the medicine cost of treating injured expedition members.
entries.translation:
*治疗*
降低治疗受伤远征队成员所需的药品消耗。

entries.source:
*Survival*
Improves the results of hunting, reducing daily use of rations.
entries.translation:
*生存*
提升狩猎成果，并减少每日口粮消耗。

entries.source:
*Scouting*
Increases your daily movement and occasionally grants better information about battles.
entries.translation:
*侦察*
提高每日移动力，并有时能提供更详细的战斗情报。

entries.source:
*Leadership*
Bolsters the starting morale of your people and raises their maximum morale, reducing the risk of mutiny.
entries.translation:
*领导力*
提升队员的初始士气和士气上限，降低兵变风险。

entries.source:
*Tactics*
Your Tactics skill plus 2 points for every healthy Soldier in your expedition. Used to intimidate enemies or change the starting situation in a battle to your advantage.
entries.translation:
*战术*
你的战术技能，加上远征队中每名健康士兵提供的2点。用于威吓敌人，或在战斗开始前改变战局，使其对你有利。

entries.source:
*Diplomacy*
Your Diplomacy skill plus 2 points for every healthy Scholar in your expedition. Affects your chances of success in negotiations and cultural exchanges.
entries.translation:
*外交*
你的外交技能，加上远征队中每名健康学者提供的2点。影响谈判和文化交流的成功率。

entries.source:
*Survival*
Your Survival skill plus 2 points for every healthy Hunter in your expedition. Improves the results of hunting, giving you more rations.
entries.translation:
*生存*
你的生存技能，加上远征队中每名健康猎人提供的2点。提升狩猎成果，为你带来更多口粮。

entries.source:
*Healing*
Your Healing skill plus 2 points for every healthy Doctor in your expedition. Improves the results of harvesting herbs, giving you more medicine.
entries.translation:
*治疗*
你的治疗技能，加上远征队中每名健康医生提供的2点。提升采集草药的成果，为你带来更多药品。

entries.source:
*Scouting*
Your Scouting skill plus 2 points for every healthy Scout in your expedition. The higher your Scouting, the farther you can move every day.
entries.translation:
*侦察*
你的侦察技能，加上远征队中每名健康斥候提供的2点。侦察能力越高，每日可移动的距离越远。

entries.source:
*Leadership*
Your Leadership skill plus 3 points for each healthy Sergeant and 4 for a Lieutenant. Bolsters the morale of your people and raises their maximum morale, reducing the risk of mutiny.
entries.translation:
*领导力*
你的领导力技能，加上每名健康中士提供的3点，以及每名中尉提供的4点。提升队员的士气和士气上限，降低兵变风险。

entries.source:
*Recruit*
Your basic inexperienced troops. No bonuses.
entries.translation:
*新兵*
你的基础新兵，缺乏经验，没有加成。

entries.source:
*Man-At-Arms (100 XP)*
+5% Attack, +5 points to Defence. Unlocks medium equipment tier.
entries.translation:
*武装步兵（100经验值）*
攻击+5%，防御+5点。解锁中级装备等级。

entries.source:
*Man-At-Arms*
+5% Attack, +5 points to Defence. Unlocks medium equipment tier.
Cost to promote: 100 experience
entries.translation:
*武装步兵*
攻击+5%，防御+5点。解锁中级装备等级。
晋升费用：100经验

entries.source:
*Veteran (300 XP)*
+10% Attack, +10 points to Defence, +1 to your Leadership. Unlocks highest equipment tier.
entries.translation:
*老兵（300经验值）*
攻击+10%，防御+10点，领导力+1。解锁最高级装备等级。

entries.source:
*Veteran*
+10% Attack, +10 points to Defence, +1 to your Leadership. Unlocks highest equipment tier.
Cost to promote: 300 experience
entries.translation:
*老兵*
攻击+10%，防御+10点，领导力+1。解锁最高级装备等级。
晋升费用：300经验

entries.source:
*Sergeant (600 XP)*
+15% Attack, +15 points to Defence, +3 to your Leadership. Maximum 3 officers allowed.
entries.translation:
*中士（600经验值）*
攻击+15%，防御+15点，领导力+3。最多允许3名军官。

entries.source:
*Sergeant*
+15% Attack, +15 points to Defence, +3 to your Leadership. Maximum 3 officers allowed.
Cost to promote: 600 experience
entries.translation:
*中士*
攻击+15%，防御+15点，领导力+3。最多允许3名军官。
晋升费用：600经验

entries.source:
*Lieutenant (1000 XP)*
+20% Attack, +20 points to Defence, +5 to your Leadership. Maximum 1 Lieutenant allowed.
entries.translation:
*中尉（1000经验值）*
攻击+20%，防御+20点，领导力+5。最多允许1名中尉。

entries.source:
*Lieutenant*
+20% Attack, +20 points to Defence, +5 to your Leadership. Maximum 1 Lieutenant allowed.
Cost to promote: 1000 experience
entries.translation:
*中尉*
攻击+20%，防御+20点，领导力+5。最多允许1名中尉。
晋升费用：1000经验

entries.source: You already have three officers in your expedition.
entries.translation: 你的远征队中已经有三名军官。

entries.source: You already have a Lieutenant in your expedition.
entries.translation: 你的远征队中已经有一名中尉。

entries.source: Every attack reduces a character's Endurance. If the Endurance reaches 0, the character will become incapacitated.
entries.translation: 每次攻击都会降低角色的耐力。耐力降至0时，该角色将会失去行动能力。

entries.source: Defence (including Equipment assigned to the character's Armour score) and the result is subtracted as a percentage from all damage sustained.
entries.translation: 防御（包括计入角色护甲值的装备加成）会按百分比减免所受的所有伤害。

entries.source: The damage dealt by a melee attack is the character's Attack plus the weapon's damage including Equipment assigned to their Melee score. The Critical Hit chance is half the character's morale and the damage multiplier is determined by the weapon type.
entries.translation: 近战攻击造成的伤害等于角色的攻击值加上武器伤害（包括计入其近战值的装备加成）。暴击几率为角色士气的一半，伤害倍率由武器类型决定。

entries.source: The character's ranged Accuracy determines the chance to hit at point blank range. If the attack is successful, the weapon's damage is applied including Equipment assigned to their Ranged score. The Critical Hit chance is half the character's morale and the damage multiplier is determined by the weapon type.
entries.translation: 角色的远程命中率决定其在近距离射击时的命中几率。攻击成功后，武器伤害将计入角色远程值所包含的装备加成。暴击几率为角色士气的一半，伤害倍率由武器类型决定。

entries.source: How many spaces a character can move each turn during a battle. Characters may move twice if they don't attack.
entries.translation: 战斗中，角色每回合可以移动的格数。若不进行攻击，角色可以移动两次。

*近战武器*
提高近战伤害

*远程武器*
提高远程伤害

entries.source: Determines the character's effectiveness when assigned to Guard the camp.
entries.translation: 决定角色被安排在营地担任卫兵时的效能。

entries.source: Determines the character's chance to discover something when sent on Patrol.
entries.translation: 决定角色被派去巡逻时发现事物的几率。

entries.source: Raises the amount of Meat you get when assigning the character to Hunt, and determines the amount of Meat the character can Preserve.
entries.translation: 将角色安排去狩猎时，可提高获得的肉类数量；同时决定该角色能腌制多少肉类。

entries.source: Determines the amount of Herbs the character can turn into Medicine each night.
entries.translation: 决定角色每晚能将多少草药制成药品。

entries.source: Decreases the materials needed to construct items and the time needed to complete upgrades.
entries.translation: 减少建造物品所需的材料，以及完成升级所需的时间。

entries.source:
*Soldier*
+2 to Tactics. Slow but tough melee fighters. Poor aim in ranged combat.
entries.translation:
*士兵*
战术+2。行动迟缓但坚韧的近战战士。远程战斗时命中率较低。

entries.source:
*Hunter*
+2 to Survival. Accurate and lethal shooters, but vulnerable and weak in melee.
entries.translation:
*猎人*
生存+2。射击精准、杀伤力强，但身板脆弱，近战能力较差。

entries.source:
*Scout*
+2 to Scouting. Fast and lethal melee fighters, but cannot use ranged weapons.
entries.translation:
*斥候*
侦察+2。行动迅捷、杀伤力强的近战战士，但无法使用远程武器。

entries.source:
*Doctor*
+2 to Healing. Poor fighters but useful support units that can restore Endurance or revive incapacitated troops.
entries.translation:
*医生*
治疗+2。战斗能力较差，但作为支援单位十分有用，可以恢复耐力或复活失去战斗能力的士兵。

entries.source:
*Scholar*
+2 to Diplomacy. Useful support units that can add a lot of flexibility to your force.
entries.translation:
*学者*
外交+2。作为支援单位十分有用，能大幅提升队伍的灵活性。

entries.source:
*Champion*
+2 to Tactics. Slow but tough and strong melee fighters. Poor aim in ranged combat.
entries.translation:
*勇士*
战术+2。行动迟缓但坚韧强悍的近战战士。远程战斗时命中率较低。

entries.source:
*Trapper*
+2 to Survival. Accurate and lethal shooters, but vulnerable and weak in melee.
entries.translation:
*设陷者*
生存+2。射击精准、杀伤力强，但身板脆弱，近战能力较差。

entries.source:
*Warrior*
+2 to Scouting. Fast and lethal melee fighters. Poor aim in ranged combat.
entries.translation:
*战士*
侦察+2。行动迅捷、杀伤力强的近战战士。远程战斗时命中率较低。

entries.source:
*Shaman*
+2 to Healing. Poor fighters but useful support units that can restore Endurance or inflict negative effects on enemies.
entries.translation:
*萨满*
治疗+2。战斗能力较差，但作为支援单位十分有用，可以恢复耐力或对敌人施加负面效果。

entries.source:
*Civilian*
+2 to Diplomacy. Higher-than-average starting skills, but very weak combat unit.
entries.translation:
*平民*
外交+2。初始技能高于平均水平，但战斗能力很弱。

entries.source:
*Amazon*
No stat bonus. Powerful guerilla fighters who are highly mobile but vulnerable to attack.
entries.translation:
*亚马逊女战士*
属性无加成。强悍的游击战士，机动性极高，但容易受到攻击。

entries.source:
*Sword and shield*
Medium damage, normal critical hit multiplier. 25% chance to block 25% damage.
entries.translation:
*剑盾*
中等伤害，暴击倍率普通。有25%的几率格挡25%的伤害。

entries.source:
*Macuahuitl and shield*
Medium damage, normal critical hit multiplier. 25% chance to block 25% damage.
entries.translation:
*马夸维特尔与盾*
中等伤害，暴击倍率普通。有25%的几率格挡25%的伤害。

entries.source:
*Pole-arm*
High damage, low critical hit multiplier.
entries.translation:
*长柄武器*
伤害高，暴击倍率低。

entries.source:
*Spear*
Medium damage, high critical hit multiplier.
entries.translation:
*长矛*
中等伤害，暴击倍率高。

entries.source:
*Dagger
Low damage, high critical hit multiplier.
entries.translation:
*匕首
伤害低，暴击倍率高。

entries.source:
*Knife*
Low damage, high critical hit multiplier.
entries.translation:
*小刀*
伤害低，暴击倍率高。

entries.source:
*Arquebus*
High damage, normal critical hit multiplier. Short range.
entries.translation:
*火绳枪*
伤害高，暴击倍率普通。射程短。

entries.source:
*Blowgun*
Low damage, very high critical hit multiplier. Short range.
entries.translation:
*吹箭筒*
伤害低，暴击倍率极高。射程短。

entries.source:
*Shortbow*
Medium damage, normal critical hit multiplier. Long range.
entries.translation:
*短弓*
中等伤害，暴击倍率普通。射程远。

entries.source:
*Hunting bow*
Medium damage, normal critical hit multiplier. Long range.
entries.translation:
*猎弓*
中等伤害，暴击倍率普通。射程远。

entries.source:
*No Weapon*
The unit cannot use ranged weapons.
entries.translation:
*无武器*
该单位无法使用远程武器。

entries.source: has been assigned to guard the camp from intruders
entries.translation: 已被安排守卫营地，防范入侵者

entries.source:
*Guarding*
A higher Guarding score lowers the risk of bad things happening when you make camp.
entries.translation:
*守卫*
守卫值越高，扎营时发生不测的风险就越低。

entries.source: has been assigned to patrol for points of interest
entries.translation: 已被安排巡逻，寻找兴趣点

entries.source:
*Patrolling*
A higher Patrolling score raises the chance of finding something interesting when you make camp.
entries.translation:
*巡逻*
巡逻值越高，扎营时发现有趣事物的几率就越大。

entries.source: has been assigned to hunt for new Meat
entries.translation: 已被安排狩猎，以获取肉类

entries.source:
*Hunting*
A higher Hunting score increases the amount of Meat you can acquire when you make camp.
entries.translation:
*狩猎*
狩猎值越高，扎营时能获得的肉类就越多。

entries.source: has been assigned to preserve Meat into Rations
entries.translation: 已被安排腌制肉类，制作口粮

entries.source:
*Preserving*
Preserving indicates how much Meat you will be able to turn into Rations.
entries.translation:
*腌制*
腌制值决定你能将多少肉类制成口粮。

entries.source: has been assigned to process Herbs into Medicine
entries.translation: 已被指派将草药加工成药品

entries.source:
*Herbalism*
Herbalism determines how many Herbs you will be able to turn into Medicine.
entries.translation:
*草药学*
草药学决定你能将多少草药制成药品。

entries.source: has been assigned to construct a new item
has been assigned to work on
has been assigned to a contextual task
entries.translation: 已被指派执行特定任务

entries.source: has not been assigned to any task

entries.translation: 守卫、巡逻、狩猎、草药学、巧手

entries.translation: [NAME]的技艺还不足以参与这项发明的制作。

entries.source: You have no Herbs to create Medicine from.
entries.translation: 你没有可用来制作药品的草药。

*+25% 木材*

Better pick axes that give you more metal during exploration.

更好的镐，探索时能让你获得更多金属。

Better pick axes that give you more metal during exploration.

更好的镐，探索时能让你获得更多金属。

*+20% 金属*

Better pick axes that give you more metal during exploration.

更好的镐，探索时能让你获得更多金属。

*+25% 金属*

entries.source:
Faster carts that allow you to move farther every day.
It takes 8 days and requires a Tinkering skill of 2 to reach this level.
*+1 movement*
entries.translation:
更快的马车，让你每天都能走得更远。
需要8天，并且巧手等级达到2，才能制作此级别。
*+1 移动力*

entries.source:
Faster carts that allow you to move farther every day.

*+3 movement*
entries.translation:
更快的马车，让你每天都能走得更远。

*+3 移动力*

Faster carts that allow you to move farther every day.

*+6 movement*
entries.translation:
更快的马车，让你每天都能走得更远。

*+6 移动力*

entries.source: No food assigned - follower will lose morale!
entries.translation: 未分配食物——随从会失去士气！

entries.source:
*Flawless Defence [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
Adds the Soldier's melee attack to their Defence.
entries.translation:
*完美防御 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
将士兵的近战攻击加入其防御。

entries.source:
*Stun [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
Use on an enemy. The target will become stunned and lose its next turn.
entries.translation:
*击晕 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
对一名敌人使用，使目标陷入眩晕并失去下一回合。

entries.source:
*Guard [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
All units adjacent to the Soldier get their Defence raised to match the Soldier's.
entries.translation:
*防守 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
士兵周围相邻的所有单位，其防御都会提升至与该士兵相同。

entries.source:
*Charge [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
Deals 5 extra points of damage for every space moved just prior to the attack.
entries.translation:
*冲锋 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
每在攻击前移动一格，便额外造成5点伤害。

entries.source:
*Swipe [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
Attacks 3 adjacent spaces simultaneously.
entries.translation:
*横扫 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
同时攻击相邻的3格。

entries.source:
*Quick Shot [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
You may make two ranged attacks with 30 points less of base accuracy.
entries.translation:
*快速射击 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
可以进行两次远程攻击，但基础命中率各降低30点。

entries.source:
*Aimed Shot [HOTKEY] Full turn action, cooldown 1 turn*
Makes an attack with only half the normal distance penalties to accuracy.
entries.translation:
*瞄准射击 [HOTKEY] 完整回合行动，冷却1回合*
攻击时，距离对命中率造成的惩罚减半。

entries.source:
*Rebuke [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
A weak melee attack that moves the target unit one space away from the Hunter.
entries.translation:
*斥退 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
以一次威力较弱的近战攻击，将目标单位击退到离猎人更远一格的位置。

entries.source:
*Poison Sting [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
Makes a ranged attack that applies a small damage-over-time effect on hit.
entries.translation:
*毒刺 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
进行一次远程攻击，命中时施加轻微的持续伤害效果。

entries.source:
*Hailstorm [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 3 turns*
Rains projectiles down on 5 random adjacent spaces in and around the target space. Can damage allied units.
entries.translation:
*冰雹箭雨 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却3回合*
以目标格及其周围的格子为候选范围，随机选取5格降下箭矢。可能伤及友军单位。

entries.source:
*Restore [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
Restores some of the targeted ally's lost Endurance. Amount restored depends on the Doctor's rank.
entries.translation:
*恢复 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
恢复目标友军损失的部分耐力。恢复量取决于医生的军衔。

entries.source:
*Cure [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
Removes all damage-over-time effects and negative effects from an ally unit and heals 15-25 points of Endurance.
entries.translation:
*治疗 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
移除一名友军单位身上的所有持续伤害和负面效果，并恢复其15至25点耐力。

entries.source:
*Revive [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 3 turns*
Brings an incapacitated ally back to their feet, with Endurance depending on the Doctor's rank.
entries.translation:
*复活 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却3回合*
使一名失去战斗能力的友军重新站起，其耐力取决于医生的军衔。

entries.source:
*Curse [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
Puts a penalty on the target's Ranged Accuracy and Defence for three turns.
entries.translation:
*诅咒 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
使目标的远程命中率和防御降低，持续3回合。

entries.source:
*Terrify [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
Forces the target unit to flee from the Shaman at its full speed.
entries.translation:
*恐吓 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
迫使目标以全速逃离萨满。

entries.source:
*Logistics [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
Gives an ally 2 more moves if the Scholar is a Recruit, 4 if Veteran, and 6 if Sergeant.
entries.translation:
*后勤 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
若学者是新兵，则使一名盟友的移动距离增加2格；若是老兵，则增加4格；若是中士，则增加6格。

entries.source:
*Coordinate Attack [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
The next attack on every enemy in this turn will deal 10% more damage.
entries.translation:
*协同攻击 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
本回合内，所有敌人受到的下一次攻击伤害提高10%。

entries.source:
*Distraction [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
Reduces the Melee and Ranged Damage of all enemies by 20% for one turn.
entries.translation:
*分散注意 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
所有敌人的近战和远程伤害降低20%，持续1回合。

entries.source:
*Sneak [HOTKEY] Move action*
Move at half speed without triggering traps, Interrupts, or Attacks of Opportunity.
entries.translation:
*潜行 [HOTKEY] 移动行动*
以一半速度移动，且不会触发陷阱、打断或借机攻击。

entries.source:
*Feint [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turn*
Move directly through a hex occupied by an enemy unit, then make an attack on them.
entries.translation:
*佯攻 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
移动穿过敌方单位占据的六边形，然后攻击该敌人。

entries.source:
*Throwing Knife [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 3 turns*
Throws a knife at a target 3 hexes away from the Scout.
entries.translation:
*飞刀 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却3回合*
向距离斥候3格的目标投掷小刀。

entries.source:
*Taunt [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
Compels the target to move three spaces towards the Warrior.
entries.translation:
*嘲讽 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
迫使目标向战士移动3格。

entries.source:
*Anticipate Opening [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 1 turns*
Guarantees that any attack by the Warrior in the next turn will be critical.
entries.translation:
*预判破绽 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却1回合*
保证战士下一回合的任何攻击都会造成暴击。

entries.source:
*Acrobatic Strike [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 2 turns*
Makes an attack and moves one space away without incurring Attack of Opportunity.
entries.translation:
*杂技突袭 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却2回合*
发动攻击后移动一格，不会招致借机攻击。

entries.source:
*Deft Strike [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 3 turns*
Makes an attack that bypasses the target's Defence (but not Armour).
entries.translation:
*灵巧打击 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却3回合*
发动攻击时无视目标的防御（但护甲仍有效）。

entries.source:
*Smoke Bomb [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 3 turns*
Throws a bomb that adds partial cover in a one-space radius around the target.
entries.translation:
*烟雾弹 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却3回合*
投出一枚炸弹，在目标周围1格范围内形成部分掩护。

entries.source:
*Rally [HOTKEY] Attack action, cooldown 3 turns*
All other units move 3 spaces towards the Lieutenant.
entries.translation:
*鼓舞 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动，冷却3回合*
所有其他单位向中尉移动3格。

entries.source:
*Golden Spear [HOTKEY] Free action*
Throw the Golden Spear at a certain hex. It will land at the start of your next turn and deal 150 damage (minus Defence) to whatever unit occupies the space at that point.
entries.translation:
*黄金长矛 [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
将黄金长矛投向指定六边形。它会在你下一回合开始时落下，对当时占据该格的单位造成150点伤害（减去防御值）。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Barricade[s] [HOTKEY] Free action*
Place an obstacle in 1 space on the battlefield.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 路障[s] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
在战场上的1格放置障碍物。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Spike Trap[s] [HOTKEY] Free action*
The first unit that moves into the space takes damage.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 尖刺陷阱[s] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
第一个进入该格的单位会受到伤害。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Net Trap[s] [HOTKEY] Free action*
The first unit that moves into the space immediately ends its turn.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 网陷阱[s] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
第一个进入该格的单位会立即结束回合。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Caltrop Trap[s] [HOTKEY] Free action*
Reduce the moves of the first unit that moves into the space.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 铁蒺藜陷阱[s] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
降低第一个进入该格的单位的移动力。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Torch[es] [HOTKEY] Free action*
Throw a torch to light up an area to negate ranged penalties in night battles.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 火把[es] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
投出火把照亮一片区域，以消除夜战中的远程攻击惩罚。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Lantern[s] [HOTKEY] Free action*
Throw a lantern full of oil to set an enemy on fire.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 提灯[s] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
投出一盏装满油料的提灯，使敌人着火。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Cannonball[s] [HOTKEY] Free action*
*Preparation Phase:* Place the cannon.
*During Combat:* Fire an explosive cannonball from the cannon that damages 5 random adjacent spaces in and around the target space.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 炮弹[s] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
*战前准备阶段：* 放置火炮。
*战斗中：* 从火炮发射一枚爆炸炮弹，对目标格及周围随机5个相邻格造成伤害。

entries.source:
*[Stack] Flask[s] of Healing Water [HOTKEY] Free action*
Use the sacred water of the Fountain of Youth to fully restore a friendly unit's endurance.
entries.translation:
*[Stack] 治疗圣水瓶[s] [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
使用青春泉的圣水，使一名友军单位的耐力完全恢复。

entries.source:
*Crystal of Mictlan [HOTKEY] Free action*
Converts an enemy of Sergeant or lower rank to fight for your side for 3 turns.
entries.translation:
*米克特兰水晶 [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
将军衔不高于中士的敌人转化为己方单位，持续3回合。

entries.source:
*Heirloom Medallion [HOTKEY] Free action*
A shiny amulet. It may or may not do anything.
entries.translation:
*祖传护符 [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
一枚闪亮的护符。它可能有用，也可能什么用都没有。

entries.source:
*Gutiérrez's Banner [HOTKEY] Free action*
Places a Banner that doubles the morale of units within 1 space of the banner.
entries.translation:
*古铁雷斯的旗帜 [HOTKEY] 免费行动*
放置一面旗帜，使其1格范围内单位的士气加倍。

entries.source:
*Tactical Move [HOTKEY] Attack action*
Allows you to move past, or away from, enemies without provoking attacks of opportunity.
entries.translation:
*战术移动 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动*
允许你经过或远离敌人，而不触发借机攻击。

entries.source:
*Interrupt [HOTKEY] Attack action*
Instead of attacking this turn, you delay the unit's action until the enemy's turn - if any enemy unit moves within 6 spaces, your unit will shoot.
entries.translation:
*打断 [HOTKEY] 攻击行动*
本回合不攻击，而是将该单位的行动延迟到敌方回合——若有敌方单位进入6格范围内，你的单位就会开火。

entries.source:
*Spot Traps [HOTKEY] Move action*
Halves moves. Reveals any trap that the character comes within melee range of. The character stops when a trap is spotted.
entries.translation:
*发现陷阱 [HOTKEY] 移动行动*
移动力减半。角色进入陷阱的近战范围时会发现陷阱；发现陷阱后角色会停下。

entries.source: A post-processing effect that simulates over-exposure due to bright sunlight. Gives the game a warmer and more vibrant look, but adds a subtle blur to everything as well.
entries.translation: 一种后期处理效果，模拟强烈阳光造成的过度曝光。它会让游戏画面显得更温暖、更鲜艳，同时也会为画面添加轻微模糊。

entries.source: The gamma slider adjusts the brightness of the game.
entries.translation: 伽马滑块用于调整游戏画面的亮度。

entries.source: Vsync synchronizes your frames per second with your monitor refresh rate, which can reduce tearing in some instances.
entries.translation: 垂直同步会使每秒帧数与显示器刷新率同步，在某些情况下可以减少画面撕裂。

entries.source: Various post processing effects that are one-off, such as the blur on the title screen. Disabling this is recommended if you're having trouble with transparent things going missing.
entries.translation: 各种独立的后期处理效果，例如标题画面上的模糊效果。如果遇到透明物体消失的问题，建议关闭此选项。

entries.source: Uncheck this box to disable shadows. This will improve performance, but the game will look terrible, so please consider it a last resort.
entries.translation: 取消勾选此框即可关闭阴影。这样可以提升性能，但游戏画面会变得很难看，所以请将此选项作为最后手段。

entries.source: Select the language for the text in events, goals, character bios, etc.
entries.translation: 选择事件、目标、角色简介等文本所用的语言。

entries.source: Select the language for the interface buttons, labels, tooltips, player messages, etc.
entries.translation: 选择界面按钮、标签、工具提示、玩家消息等内容所使用的语言。

entries.source: Disable tutorials completely (they will not show up in the right side of the screen).
entries.translation: 完全禁用教程（教程将不会显示在屏幕右侧）。

entries.source: Disable tutorial pop-ups so they don't appear automatically.
entries.translation: 禁用教程弹窗，避免它们自动出现。

entries.source: Speed up the combat if you're a particularly impatient player.
entries.translation: 如果你特别没有耐心，可以加快战斗速度。

entries.source: The camera will automatically lock onto the active enemy unit when it's not your turn.
entries.translation: 非你的回合时，镜头会自动锁定当前行动的敌方单位。

entries.source: You can pan the camera during combat by simply moving your cursor to the edge of the screen.
entries.translation: 战斗中，只需将光标移到屏幕边缘即可平移镜头。

entries.source: Damage, status effects, and so on will appear above the heads of units during combat.
entries.translation: 战斗中，单位头顶会显示伤害、状态效果等信息。

entries.source: How many seconds should player messages stay on the screen?
entries.translation: 玩家消息应在屏幕上停留多少秒？

entries.source: Lowering the resolution of the terrain increases performance a lot but makes the game world look less detailed.
entries.translation: 降低地形分辨率可大幅提升性能，但会让游戏世界的细节减少。

entries.source: Reduces the level-of-detail distance of the terrain, making it appear more jagged from afar.
entries.translation: 降低地形的细节显示距离，使地形从远处看起来更加参差不齐。

entries.source: Shader-based outline highlights on interactive objects look pretty but add an extra render pass that reduces performance.
entries.translation: 基于着色器的轮廓高亮能让可互动对象更醒目，但会增加一次渲染过程，降低性能。

entries.source: The amount of resources you get from pick-ups during your travels.
entries.translation: 旅途中拾取物资时可获得的资源数量。

entries.source: Difficulty multiplier on the damage dealt by the attacks of your units.
entries.translation: 难度系数会影响你的单位攻击所造成的伤害。

entries.source: Difficulty multiplier on the damage dealt against your units by enemy attacks.
entries.translation: 难度系数会影响敌方攻击对你的单位造成的伤害。

entries.source: The critical hit probability of enemy units.
Determines how many mistakes your opponents make and how often they will use special abilities and focus fire.
entries.translation: 决定对手会犯多少错误，以及使用特殊能力和集火攻击的频率。

entries.source: The probabilities of your troops sustaining serious injuries when incapacitated in battle.
entries.translation: 你的部队在战斗中失去行动能力时，遭受严重伤势的概率。

entries.source: When Sudden Death is enabled, your units may die outright if incapacitated for enough turns. Enable at your own risk!
entries.translation: 启用“猝死”后，你的单位若失去行动能力达到一定回合数，可能会直接死亡。启用风险自负！

entries.source: Switch between full-screen and windowed mode.
Select the resolution in which to display the game.
entries.translation: 选择游戏的显示分辨率。

entries.source: Select a preset for the graphical quality - overrides the Advanced settings below!
entries.translation: 选择一个画质预设——这会覆盖下方的高级设置！

entries.source: The resolution of the textures in the game world.
entries.translation: 游戏世界中纹理的分辨率。

entries.source: A post-processing effect that smoothes the edges of the game objects.
entries.translation: 一种后期处理效果，可平滑游戏物体的边缘。

entries.source: The overall quality of the water (reflection, edge blend, etc.)
entries.translation: 水面的整体质量（反射、边缘融合等）。

entries.source: A post-processing effect that adjusts the colours of the game.
entries.translation: 一种用于调整游戏色彩的后期处理效果。

entries.source: A post-processing effect that increases the contrast of the game.
entries.translation: 一种用于提高游戏对比度的后期处理效果。

entries.source: Screen-Spaced Ambient Occlusion is a post-processing effect that gives the game's visual style much more depth.
entries.translation: 屏幕空间环境光遮蔽是一种后期处理效果，可大幅增强游戏画面的纵深感。

entries.source: A post-processing effect that adds moody fog to the game based on the position of the camera.
entries.translation: 一种后期处理效果，会根据镜头位置为游戏画面添加氛围雾效。

entries.source: Change the volume of the music.
Change the volume of the combat sounds, interface sounds, etc.
entries.translation: 调整战斗音效、界面音效等的音量。

entries.source: Change the volume of the ambient soundscapes.
Type your character's first name here.
entries.translation: 在这里输入角色的名字。

entries.source: Type your character's last name here.
entries.translation: 在这里输入角色的姓氏。

entries.source: Select an expedition member above and click 'Hire' to add them to the list. Select a hired expedition member and click 'Dismiss' to remove them from your expedition again. You must select 10 expedition members to proceed.
entries.translation: 选择上方的一名远征队成员并点击“雇用”，即可将其加入名单。选择一名已雇用的远征队成员并点击“解雇”，即可将其从远征队中移除。你必须选择10名远征队成员才能继续。

entries.source: Click this to automatically select 10 people for your expedition. You can also hire individual members by clicking on their portraits above.
entries.translation: 点击此处可自动为远征队选择10人。你也可以点击上方的头像，逐一雇用成员。

entries.source: Your Available Experience points are used to promote your troops. Total Experience is a record of how much experience you've earned throughout the game.
entries.translation: 可用经验值用于晋升你的部队。总经验值记录了你在整个游戏过程中获得的经验总量。

entries.source: Experience points are used to promote your troops.
entries.translation: 经验值用于晋升你的部队。

entries.source: You can assign this equipment to your expedition members with the plus and minus buttons above.
entries.translation: 你可以使用上方的加号和减号按钮，将这件装备分配给远征队成员。

entries.source: The overall morale of your expedition. Individual morale is capped by your Leadership score. If this says "Mutinous", you should be worried.
entries.translation: 远征队的整体士气。个人士气受领导力数值限制。如果这里显示“哗变”，你就该担心了。

entries.source: Set an active goal marker on the mapscreen.
entries.translation: 在地图屏幕上设置一个当前目标标记。

entries.source:
*Equipped Items*
Move items to these slots to bring them with you into your next battle.
entries.translation:
*已装备物品*
将物品移动至这些栏位，即可在下一场战斗中随身携带。

entries.source:
*Stored Items*
Items in these slots can not be used in battle.
entries.translation:
*存放物品*
这些栏位中的物品无法在战斗中使用。

entries.source: You must fill in your first and last name and assign all skill points before moving on.
entries.translation: 继续之前，你必须填写名字和姓氏，并分配所有技能点。

entries.source: You must hire 10 expedition members before moving on.
entries.translation: 你必须雇用10名远征队成员才能继续前进。

entries.source: The severity and type of the injury determines the daily treatment cost and how likely it is to get worse if left untreated.
entries.translation: 伤势的严重程度和类型决定了每日治疗费用，以及若不治疗，伤势恶化的可能性。

entries.source: The risk of this injury getting worse each day if left untreated. The more severe the injury, the greater the deterioration risk.
entries.translation: 若不治疗，这处伤势每天恶化的风险。伤势越严重，恶化风险越高。

entries.source: How much medicine it will cost to treat this expedition member. Each time an injury is treated, the cost will decrease.
entries.translation: 治疗这名远征队成员的伤势需要多少药品。每治疗一次伤势，费用都会降低。
分配给这名患者的医生。
分配给这名医生的患者。

entries.source:
Welcome to Character Creation. This is where you choose what kind of Conquistador you wish to be. Your choices in this menu and the following will influence your opportunities and challenges throughout the game. But don't be alarmed! The decisions you make here may make the game harder, but they cannot make it impossible.

The current screen lets you set up your own character - gender, name, and skills. Your skills will influence your access to, and consumption of, resources such as medicine and rations, and skills will also open up new options during events and conversations.

You can always move your cursor over icons to see what they mean.

It is recommended that you choose two or three skills to specialise in, without lowering any of your skills completely - but feel free to follow your instincts if they tell you otherwise.

On the next screen, you will have to select the people to bring on your expedition to the New World. The different character types provide substantial bonuses to your skills, and different characters have different strengths, weaknesses, and abilities in a battle.

Each character also has three personality traits which determine what will cause them to lose or gain morale throughout your travels.
entries.translation:
欢迎来到角色创建界面。在这里，你可以选择自己要成为怎样的征服者。你在此菜单及后续菜单中的选择，将影响你在整个游戏过程中遇到的机会与挑战。不过不用担心！你在这里做出的决定或许会增加游戏难度，但不会让游戏变得无法进行。

当前界面可用于创建自己的角色——设置性别、姓名和技能。技能会影响你获取和消耗药品、口粮等资源的能力，也会在事件和对话中解锁新的选项。

将光标移到图标上，即可查看其含义。

建议选择两到三项技能进行专精，同时不要把任何一项技能降到最低；当然，如果你的直觉另有指引，也可以按自己的想法选择。

在下一个界面中，你需要选择同行者，组成远征队前往新大陆。不同的角色类型会大幅提升你的技能，而每名角色在战斗中都有各自的优势、弱点和能力。

每名角色还有三项性格特征，它们决定了在旅途中哪些事情会使其士气上升或下降。

entries.source:
The year is 1518 - a year before Hernán Cortes would be elected captain of the third expedition to the South American mainland, where he would overthrow the Aztec empire. But that will not happen, because you have beaten him to the punch.

You are the eldest child of a Spanish nobleman, and you yourself hold the title of Hidalgo. With your father's backing, you have been the leader of a successful "hermandad" (meaning "brotherhood") back in the Old World - a peacekeeping association of armed individuals which protected the countryside around your father's town.

During this time, you demonstrated an aptitude for leadership and strategy that earned you the respect of the people under your command - but it was time for a greater challenge. With the King's permission and your father's financial support, you purchased a ship and selected your crew from the best of the brothers and sisters in your hermandad.

Together, you are off on the long and arduous journey to explore the New World. In your cargo hold, you bring rations, medicine, equipment, and assorted valuables. You must first make a stop on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola, under Spanish domain since 1496. Here, you will hire servants or buy slaves, rest and restock, and gain what information you can about the New World.

After five weeks on the Atlantic Ocean, your people gather on the deck as the call "Land ahoy!" rings out from the rigging. On a clear afternoon, gulls screeching in the wake of your ship, you sail into the port of Santo Domingo, the seat of Spanish colonial rule in the New World.
entries.translation:
现在是 1518 年——再过一年，埃尔南·科尔特斯就会当选第三支远征队的队长，前往南美洲大陆，并推翻阿兹特克帝国。但这一切不会发生，因为你抢在了他前头。

你是西班牙一位贵族最年长的孩子，自己也拥有伊达尔戈头衔。在父亲的支持下，你曾在旧大陆成功领导一个名为“hermandad”（意为“兄弟会”）的组织——这是一个由武装人员组成的治安团体，负责保护你父亲所在城镇周边的乡间地区。

在此期间，你展现出卓越的领导力与战略眼光，赢得了麾下众人的敬重——但如今，该迎接更大的挑战了。在国王许可和父亲资助下，你买下一艘船只，并从兄弟会的成员中挑选出最优秀的男女，组成船员队伍。

你们就此踏上漫长而艰辛的旅程，去探索新大陆。货舱里装着口粮、药品、装备以及各种贵重物品。你们必须先在加勒比海的伊斯帕尼奥拉岛停靠；自 1496 年起，该岛便处于西班牙的统治之下。在那里，你们会雇用仆人或购买奴隶，休整并补充物资，还要尽可能打听新大陆的消息。

横渡大西洋五周后，桅杆上响起“陆地！陆地！”的呼喊，你的同伴们纷纷聚集到甲板上。一个晴朗的午后，海鸥在船尾啼叫，你们驶入圣多明各港口——这里是西班牙在新大陆殖民统治的中心。
