entries.source: Born in 1469, he had a relatively normal childhood, growing up in a small farm town. He met the love of his life, whom he married at a young age. He was apprenticing as an alchemist when his wife fell ill from typhus and died a short while later. The loss sent him into a deep depression and he buried himself in his work and the field of disease treatment. He never fully recovered from his broken heart, and partly the reason he joined your expedition was to get over his grief. A somber and quiet man, but no man knows better the field of diseases and infections than he.
entries.translation: 他生于1469年，童年生活相当平凡，在一座小型农庄镇长大。他很早便与一生挚爱结了婚。当他还在做炼金术士学徒时，妻子染上斑疹伤寒，不久便去世了。这场失去让他陷入深深的抑郁；他把自己埋进工作中，专心钻研疾病治疗。他始终没能从心碎中完全恢复，而他加入你们的远征，部分原因也是想走出悲痛。他是个沉郁寡言的人，但论疾病与感染，无人比他更精通。

entries.source: Born in 1487 into a family of healers, her father a doctor and her mother a herbalist. Throughout her childhood she exhibited a cynical and brutal outlook, seeing the human body as nothing more than flesh which can be repaired like anything else. Her dispassion and cynicism are troubling, but her skills are flawless and unmatched.
entries.translation: 1487年，她出生于一个医者世家，父亲是医生，母亲是草药师。童年时期，她便显露出愤世嫉俗、冷酷无情的一面，在她眼中，人体不过是一堆血肉，和其他东西一样可以修补。她的冷漠与愤世嫉俗令人不安，但她的医术无懈可击，无人能及。

entries.source: Teresa's mother died when she was giving birth, launching her father into a deep depression from which he never recovered. Seeing suffering all around her as a child, she grew determined to help people get well. Before joining your expedition, she was the local doctor in your area, where she excelled particularly in stitching wounds.
entries.translation: 特蕾莎的母亲在生下她时去世，父亲因此陷入深深的抑郁，再也没能振作起来。童年时目睹身边的人饱受苦难，她便下定决心帮助人们恢复健康。在加入你的远征队之前，她是你领地附近的医生，尤其擅长缝合伤口。

entries.source: Not much is known about Antonio, beside him being an extremely talented doctor. How he gained the knowledge he possesses or the skills that he exhibits are a mystery. Wandering into town from the forest on a day like any other, he quickly attracted a crowd of curious people in the poor quarters. He went from person to person and, with simple remedies, made almost every sick person better. His sympathetic nature is unmatched and he can make any person feel welcome in his company.
entries.translation: 人们对安东尼奥知之甚少，只知道他是一位天赋异禀的医生。他如何获得这些知识、练就这些本领，至今仍是谜。有一天，他像往常一样从森林走进镇子，很快便吸引了贫民区一群好奇的人。他挨家挨户地走访，用简单的药物治好了几乎每一位病人。他富有同情心，无人能及；无论是谁，都能在他身边感到自在。

entries.source: Born in servitude to your family, Sierra started her training as a squire. She developed a taste for combat very quickly and her skills became apparent to you. At your suggestion she joined your hermandad as a full-time soldier, and has been training there for the past several years before you went on your expedition.
entries.translation: 谢拉生来便是你家中的仆役，后来开始接受侍从训练。她很快便爱上了战斗，你也逐渐发现了她的本领。在你的建议下，她加入兄弟会成为一名全职士兵；在你启程远征之前，她已在那里训练了好几年。

entries.source: Born into a family of brawlers and troublemakers, Alberto was no different. He frequently ran into trouble as a child and got his fair share of scars to prove it. Before joining your hermandad, he worked as a barkeep in a less-than-reputable establishment, where his skills in fighting were put to good use. He eventually tired of the stink and joined you, in hopes of fresh air and fresh enemies.
entries.translation: 阿尔贝托出生于一个好斗惹事的家庭，他也不例外。孩提时他常惹上麻烦，身上的伤疤就是明证。加入兄弟会之前，他在一家名声不佳的酒馆当酒保，打架的本领在那里派上了用场。最终，他厌倦了那里的臭气，便加入了你，希望呼吸新鲜空气，也找些新敌人。

entries.source: Born as a street urchin to unknown parents, she spent her childhood stealing to survive. On a particularly sunny day she ran into your father, who took pity on the small child. Her fearlessness and tenacious will to live made her a prime candidate for your army, in which she has now spent the last seven years waiting for a chance to repay her debt to your father through service.
entries.translation: 她是个弃儿，父母不详，从小靠偷窃活了下来。一个格外晴朗的日子，她遇见了你的父亲；他怜悯这个瘦小的孩子。她无所畏惧、求生意志顽强，因此成了你军中的理想人选。如今她已在军中效力七年，一直等待机会通过服役报答你父亲的恩情。

entries.source: Born in 1493 and a distant relative on your mother's side. She became noticed for hunting down a group of local bandits near her home and singlehandedly disposing of them. Her feat was more through blind luck than talent, but through training with your hermandad, she became a skilled and remarkable fighter.
entries.translation: 她生于1493年，是你母亲那边的远亲。她曾在家乡附近追踪一伙当地匪徒，并独自将他们全部除掉，因此声名鹊起。此举与其说是本领高强，不如说是运气使然；但经过在兄弟会的训练，她成长为一名技艺娴熟、表现出众的战士。

entries.source: Not much is known of Juan Ortega. Despite his ruthlessness on the field of battle, he is a polite and soft-spoken character most of the time, but he keeps to himself and doesn't speak of his past. It has been established that he served as a mercenary for a few years before travelling to Hispaniola where he joined your expedition, but nobody knows where he is from or why he chose to come to the New World. With every passing evening, the rumours concerning "Maestro" Ortega grow ever more impressive.
entries.translation: 人们对胡安·奥尔特加知之甚少。尽管他在战场上冷酷无情，平日里却彬彬有礼、寡言温和，只是深居简出，从不谈及自己的过去。据说他曾当过几年雇佣兵，后来前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛并加入你的远征队，但没人知道他来自何处，也不知道他为何选择来到新大陆。每过一个夜晚，关于“大师”奥尔特加的传闻就更加离奇。

entries.source: Young Rosalía is the daughter to your father's most trusted sword-arm. From the time she could walk, she started her training, her father determined to honour his name. Because her father had wished for a son, approval did not come easy, but she attained it. Her loyalty is unquestionable and despite her youth, her swordsmanship is flawless.
entries.translation: 年轻的罗萨莉娅是你父亲最信任的剑术高手之女。她刚学会走路便开始训练，父亲一心想让她光耀门楣。父亲曾盼望有个儿子，因此她很难得到认可；但她最终赢得了认可。她忠心耿耿，虽年纪尚轻，剑术却已炉火纯青。

entries.source: Born in 1494 on a farm on the outskirts of your fiefdom, she lost her parents to robber knights, who raided and destroyed her childhood home. Vowing her revenge, she joined your hermandad as a soldier to kill those who murdered her parents. Her revenge was eventually achieved, after which she assumed a much more calm demeanor. Her skills in combat are almost unrivaled, which is the reason she chose to stay in your service.
entries.translation: 她于1494年出生在你领地边缘的一座农场。劫掠的骑士袭击并摧毁了她儿时的家园，她的父母也因此丧命。她立誓复仇，加入兄弟会成为士兵，只为杀死那些害死父母的人。大仇得报后，她的性情平和了许多。她的战斗本领几乎无人能敌，因此选择继续为你效力。

entries.source: Guillermo Pascual was already experienced in combat at the age of 19, having fought in countless skirmishes and battles. Born into your mother's service, his family has acted as a personal militia to her family for generations. He joined your hermandad as a sergeant and helped train others while honing his own skills. Guillermo is stubborn and ruthless, yet you would be hard pressed to find a better man to bring into the fray.
entries.translation: 吉列尔莫·帕斯夸尔19岁时便已身经百战，参加过无数次小规模冲突和战斗。他生于为你母亲效力的家族；他的家族世世代代都是你母亲家族的民兵。他以中士身份加入兄弟会，一边磨练自身本领，一边协助训练他人。吉列尔莫固执而冷酷无情，但要找到比他更适合上阵杀敌的人，可不容易。

entries.source: Born in 1485 and a distant relative on your mother's side, a Hidalgo in his own right, he was persuaded to join your hermandad at the age of 19. It was hoped that his time with you would teach him some lessons in humility, but it quickly became apparent that his temper was uncontrollable. In combat, however, his temper is channeled and focused, making him an invaluable asset.
entries.translation: 他生于1485年，是你母亲一方的远亲，也是颇有身份的伊达尔戈。19岁时，他受人劝说加入了你的兄弟会。人们希望在你身边的这段日子能教会他谦逊一些，但很快大家就发现，他的脾气根本无法控制。然而在战斗中，他能将怒火引导并集中起来，成为不可多得的助力。

entries.source: Born in 1494 to a blacksmith in Madrid, where at a young age he began his life as an apprentice. At the age of 15 he began his training as a soldier under your banner. He showed a ferocity and zeal that made him stand out from the others and proved his worth as a soldier of your hermandad.
entries.translation: 他于1494年出生在马德里的一户铁匠之家，很小便开始当学徒。15岁时，他在你的旗帜下开始接受士兵训练。他表现出的凶悍与热忱令他脱颖而出，也证明了自己是兄弟会里一名合格的士兵。

entries.source: Blanca's father gave her to a nunnery at a young age, as her family could not afford to get her married. The nuns provided a harsh but stimulating childhood with a remarkably broad and scholarly educational regimen which instilled in her a love of knowledge and intellectual pursuit. When she came of age, Blanca joined a mission to Hispaniola where she helped to establish a new church on the north coast. When the opportunity arose, she jumped at the chance to follow you to the mainland and bring the word of God to the natives.
entries.translation: 布兰卡年幼时，父亲便把她送进了修道院，因为家里负担不起她的嫁妆。修女们给了她严苛却充实的童年，安排的教育课程涉猎广泛、学术气息浓厚，令她由此热爱知识与求知。成年后，布兰卡加入了一支前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的传教队伍，并协助在北海岸建立了一座新教堂。后来有机会跟随你前往美洲大陆、向原住民传播天主圣言时，她立刻抓住了这个机会。

entries.source: Daniel Reyes grew up in a family of soldiers, and he was determined to ascend from the family tradition. Though his father set him on the path of a military career, he chose to study strategy and battle tactics, and through hard work and stubbornness he earned a respectable place as a war advisor to a Marquis. But Reyes is in possession of an ever travelling mind, and when rumours from the New World reached his ears, speaking of dark cults and heathen rituals, he set his sights on those mysterious new shores. If there was ancient magic and forbidden knowledge there, it would be his.
entries.translation: 丹尼尔·雷耶斯出身士兵世家，却决心跳出家族传统。尽管父亲为他铺下了从军之路，他却选择钻研战略与战斗战术，凭借勤奋和固执，赢得了侯爵麾下一名受人尊敬的军事顾问之职。但雷耶斯的心思总在远方；新大陆有关黑暗邪教与异教仪式的传闻传入他耳中后，他便将目光投向那片神秘的新海岸。若那里真有古老魔法与禁忌知识，它们终将归他所有。

entries.source: Julio's father was killed defending his birthing mother. His parents had been travelling to your town when they were attacked by bandits. His mother escaped, wounded and breaking water. She collapsed and died close to the city gates, but luckily a young couple rescued Julio from his dying mother's womb and raised the child as their own. Because his adoptive father was the keeper of your father's library, Julio grew up surrounded by books and pamphlets alike. It was natural for him to turn to the sciences in that environment. Yet something stirred in him, driving him to seek adventure.
entries.translation: 胡里奥的父亲为保护临盆的母亲而丧命。当时父母正前往你的城镇，途中遭遇强盗袭击。母亲带伤逃脱，羊水也已破裂。她倒在城门附近，最终不幸身亡；所幸一对年轻夫妇从她弥留之际的腹中救出了胡里奥，并把他当作亲生孩子抚养。养父是你父亲图书馆的看守，因此胡里奥从小便被书籍和小册子包围。在那样的环境里，他自然而然地投身科学。可他心中仍有某种东西在涌动，驱使他去寻求冒险。

entries.source: Mercedes was born in 1496 to unknown parents. She was found on the steps at a convent where she was taken in and cared for. Growing up, she proved extremely difficult for the nuns, preferring to study fields that challenged their faith. In fear of being branded a witch, she ran away at age 13 and lived a secluded life up until joining your expedition. Her insights into mythology are unrivaled, and facing a world with a rich mythology in its own right, she is an invaluable asset.
entries.translation: 梅赛德斯于1496年出生，亲生父母不详。她在修道院的台阶上被人发现，后来被收留照料。长大后，她让修女们头疼不已，因为她偏爱研究那些挑战她们信仰的领域。她害怕被打成女巫，13岁时便逃了出去，此后一直过着隐居生活，直到加入你的远征队。她对神话的见解无人能及；面对这个本身就拥有丰富神话的世界，她是不可多得的助力。

entries.source: Zárraga is a hunter of knowledge, ruthless in his approach. No books or scrolls are unavailable to him, as any who tries to keep them from him is dragged through defamation to the verge of bankruptcy. The means always justify the end for Carlos Zárraga, and the lore and secrets of the new world WILL be revealed to him, even if it means torturing every soul he finds.
entries.translation: 萨拉加是个追逐知识的猎人，手段冷酷。没有书籍或卷轴能逃过他的手掌心：凡是试图阻拦他的人，都会遭他诽谤中伤，直至濒临破产。对卡洛斯·萨拉加而言，结果总能证明手段正当；新大陆的传说与秘密终将被他揭开，哪怕这意味着要折磨他遇到的每一个人。

entries.source: Beautiful Bonita was the daughter of a royal huntsman to the King. Her radiant charms and her incredible beauty made her the most attractive maiden in the court, to the extent that her father was forced to hire guards to keep the suitors away. What most women would kill to have was a curse to Bonita, however, as she longed to be respected and admired for her achievements rather than her looks. This desire finally drove her to run away and join your expedition.
entries.translation: 美丽的博妮塔是国王麾下一名王室猎官的女儿。她光彩照人的魅力与惊人美貌使她成为宫廷中最迷人的少女，以至于父亲不得不雇卫兵赶走求婚者。然而，别的女人梦寐以求的一切，对博妮塔而言却是诅咒：她渴望凭借自己的成就获得尊重与赞赏，而非美貌。最终，这份渴望促使她离家出走，加入你的远征队。

entries.source: Besides the year of his birth, not much is known about the past of Raúl Carrillo. For years, he was a wanted man, accused of poaching and other inappropriate activities. How he managed to escape the law for so long is unknown, but his continued freedom is a testament to his talents. He is ill-tempered and quick to anger, but in the jungles his patience knows no bounds. For hours on end he can be still, ready to pounce at the blink of an eye.
entries.translation: 除了出生年份，人们对劳尔·卡里略的过去知之甚少。多年来他一直是通缉犯，被指控偷猎及从事其他不法勾当。他如何能长期逃脱法律制裁，无人知晓；但他至今仍逍遥法外，足以证明他的本事。他脾气暴躁，动辄发怒，可在丛林里却耐心无穷。几个小时一动不动地潜伏对他而言不在话下，只等眨眼间扑向猎物。

entries.source: Born in 1489, she grew up in the city under the roof of a fletcher. Her knowledge of bows rivals any expert, and her ability to handle them exceeds even that, but she's proven to be equally handy with an arquebus. She trained with the city guard for several years, before eventually surpassing her superiors, taking over their duties in teaching her fellow students. Although not exactly humble, she is still well aware of her limitations and has an overall pleasant personality, making her a great companion.
entries.translation: 她生于1489年，在一名制弓匠家中长大。她对弓的了解足以媲美任何专家，运用弓的本领更是有过之而无不及；不过，她使用火绳枪也同样得心应手。她曾在城镇卫队训练多年，后来逐渐超越上级，接过了教导同窗的职责。她虽算不上谦逊，却很清楚自己的局限，性格总体也十分讨喜，是个很好的伙伴。

entries.source: Rafael had a good life as a hunter in Spain, until he messed it all up. Blind with baseless jealousy and drunk out of his mind, he murdered his loving wife one night on suspicion of adultery. He was caught and tried for murder, found guilty and sentenced to death. At the last possible moment, Rafael was offered a chance of pardon if he agreed to be sent to the New World and serve the Spanish Crown on expeditions to the mainland.
entries.translation: 拉斐尔曾在西班牙过着不错的猎人生活，直到他亲手毁掉了一切。他被毫无根据的嫉妒冲昏头脑，又醉得不省人事，一夜之间竟因怀疑妻子通奸而杀死了深爱他的妻子。他被捕并以谋杀罪受审，最终被判有罪、处以死刑。在行刑前的最后关头，拉斐尔得到了一次赦免机会：只要他愿意被送往新大陆，为西班牙王室效力，参加前往美洲大陆的远征。

entries.source: Alejandro was the son of a Vizconde whose house fell into disgrace and destitution when he ran afoul of a cardinal and became a target of the Inquisition. The nature and origin of the dispute that felled Pintado are murky and mysterious, and if Alejandro knows anything, he isn't willing to share it. He joined your hermandad hoping to restore honour to his name, and so far he's been doing quite well.
entries.translation: 亚历杭德罗是子爵之子。父亲得罪了一位红衣主教，成为宗教裁判所的目标后，家族便蒙羞落魄。导致平塔多家族衰败的争端究竟缘何而起、始于何处，至今仍扑朔迷离；即便亚历杭德罗知道些什么，他也不愿透露。他加入你的兄弟会，希望恢复家族名誉，迄今进展颇为顺利。

entries.source: Life was not good to Gabriela in the early years of her life. Thrown out of her family's house to fend for herself at the age of 12, she resorted to prostitution and begging to feed herself. After she nearly died following a desperate makeshift abortion, her luck finally changed when she was taken in by a lonely old woodsman who taught her hunting and tanning. Her sense of self-worth finally restored after several years of maintaining a respectable living, she joined the crew of a ship to Hispaniola, where you met her as a hunter in the forests northeast of Santo Domingo.
entries.translation: 加夫列拉早年的生活并不顺遂。12岁时，她被家人赶出家门，只能独自谋生，于是靠卖淫和乞讨糊口。一次走投无路的土法堕胎几乎要了她的命；此后她的运气终于有所好转，一位孤独的老樵夫收留了她，并教她狩猎与制革。几年间，她靠正当营生重拾自尊，随后成为一艘开往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的船只上的船员。你是在圣多明各东北方的森林里遇见她的，当时她正是一名猎人。

entries.source: Ever since he was a child, Montego always had a strong sense of civic duty and a powerful desire to find adventure and be a hero, but he was never very good at combat or very fond of killing people. When he joined your hermandad, he took up the study of maps and orienteering and quickly became the best scout in your brotherhood. As long as Montego is with you, you know that you will never get lost.
entries.translation: 蒙特戈从小就有强烈的公共责任感，满心渴望冒险、成为英雄；可他既不擅长战斗，也不喜欢杀人。加入你的兄弟会后，他开始学习地图绘制与野外寻路，很快便成了兄弟会里最出色的斥候。只要蒙特戈跟着你，你就不用担心迷路。

entries.source: Francisco is a short and slender young man with delicate features and a rogueish charm. Though he had only recently joined your hermandad by the time you left for the New World, he was eager to join your expedition. What he lacks in strength, he more than makes up for in endurance and agility, and his acrobatic tricks are particularly popular in the evening around the campfires.
entries.translation: 弗朗西斯科是个身材矮小纤瘦的年轻人，五官秀气，带着几分浪荡子的魅力。你启程前往新大陆时，他才刚加入你的兄弟会，却已迫不及待想参加远征。他力量不足之处，耐力与敏捷足以弥补；尤其是在营火旁的夜晚，他表演的杂技总是大受欢迎。

entries.source: Daniela was a farmer's daughter who married a wealthy merchant relatively late, at the age of 15. The couple travelled a lot, and Daniela quickly learned how to survive on the road, in many types of terrain and weather. Her natural talent for path finding served her husband well, and for several years, business was good. When Daniela was in her mid-20s, tragedy struck as her husband was murdered by a business partner and robbed of all his possessions. Left a destitute widow, Daniela was found and taken in by a member of your hermandad, where she put her skills to good use.
entries.translation: 丹妮埃拉是农夫的女儿，15岁时才嫁给一位富商，在当时已算相当晚婚。夫妻二人四处奔走，丹妮埃拉很快学会了如何在旅途中生存，适应各种地形与天气。她天生擅长辨路，令丈夫受益匪浅，生意也顺遂了好几年。丹妮埃拉二十多岁时遭逢变故：丈夫被生意伙伴杀害，财物也被洗劫一空。她沦为一贫如洗的寡妇，后来被你兄弟会的一名成员发现并收留，总算得以施展所长。

entries.source: Born in 1498, Raina is a stoic and professional-minded woman who joined your hermandad at an early age hoping to find a place where she could feel like she belonged. She prefers subtlety and cleverness over force and confrontation, and she possesses a seemingly endless font of tricks and knowledge of wilderness survival.
entries.translation: 蕾娜生于1498年，是个沉着而严谨的女人。她很早便加入你的兄弟会，希望找到一个真正有归属感的地方。比起强攻和正面冲突，她更偏爱隐秘行动与机敏应对；她似乎有用不完的奇招，对野外生存也颇有心得。

entries.source: The oldest person in your expedition, Federico has many years of active service experience as a soldier, but has always been too insubordinate to advance beyond a basic rank. When he offered to join your expedition, you suspected that the very qualities that made him a poor soldier - his independence and his utter lack of honour - would make him an excellent scout, and indeed Federico has since proven himself to be highly resourceful and effective in his new role.
entries.translation: 费德里科是你这支远征队中年纪最大的人。他有多年现役士兵经验，却总因桀骜不驯而无法晋升到基础军阶以上。当他提出加入远征队时，你猜想，正是那些令他成为差劲士兵的特质——独立自主、毫无荣誉感——会让他成为出色的斥候。事实证明，你的判断没错：费德里科在新职位上既机灵又能干。

entries.source: Fierce and independent Ana picked up the nickname "Pantera" among the troops early in the expedition. When on duty, she is remarkable for her ability to move unnoticed through any terrain, like a shadow that leaves no mark upon its surroundings. Needless to say, this makes her an excellent scout. Off duty, she is remarkable for having several lovers and not even attempting to conceal her conduct. Naturally, this gives rise to all sorts of gossipping, jealousy, and contempt among the troops, but Anita herself seems perfectly disinterested in all this.
entries.translation: 安娜骁勇而独立，远征初期便在军中得了“黑豹”的绰号。执行任务时，她能在任何地形中悄无声息地穿行，仿佛一道不留痕迹的影子；毫无疑问，这使她成为一名出色的斥候。休息时，她有好几位情人，而且从不试图掩饰自己的风流行径。这自然引来军中各色流言、嫉妒与鄙夷，但安娜本人似乎对此毫不在意。

entries.source: You've beaten back the rebel assault on the palace. You should find out how things look in the other parts of the town.
entries.translation: 你击退了叛军袭击宫殿的攻势。你应该去看看城镇其他地方的情况。

entries.source: The rebels have taken the palace and murdered the Governor. You must find out how things look in the other parts of the town.
entries.translation: 叛军已占领宫殿并杀害了总督。你必须查明镇上其他地区的情况。

entries.source: Visit Fortaleza Ozama and let Noriega know whenever you want to hold that tournament against his contingent.
entries.translation: 前往奥萨马堡，告诉诺列加你想何时与他的队伍举行比武大会。

entries.source: A notorious brawler named Esteban Gallego leads a rebel company that has been terrorising the Spanish mining operations in the mountains northwest of Santo Domingo. Visit the mines and track down Esteban.
entries.translation: 臭名昭著的斗殴者埃斯特班·加列戈率领一支叛军队伍，在圣多明各西北部山区不断袭扰西班牙人的采矿活动。前往矿井，追查埃斯特班。

entries.source: A band of rebels has been terrorising the north coast, and particularly the Spanish town of San Tiago de los Caballeros. Capitán Leandra Vizcaino has been stationed there to defend the town and may have learned something that you can use to track down the rebels.
entries.translation: 一伙叛军一直在北海岸肆虐，尤其是西班牙人的城镇圣地亚哥-德洛斯卡瓦列罗斯。莱安德拉·维斯卡伊诺队长驻扎在那里保护城镇，或许已经掌握了一些线索，可供你追查叛军。

entries.source: Umberto has asked you to meet him in the Santo Domingo market.
entries.translation: 翁贝托让你去圣多明各市场见他。

entries.source: Locate the old ruins in the jungle at the heart of Hispaniola and deal with the pagan cult that haunts them.
entries.translation: 前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛腹地丛林中的古老遗迹，解决盘踞在那里的异教徒教派。

entries.source: Go with Isabela de Yruenes to the harbour to regain possession of the cargo from the María Teresa.
entries.translation: 跟伊莎贝拉·德·尤鲁埃内斯前往港口，从玛丽亚·特蕾莎号上取回货物。

entries.source: Go to the Quartermaster and pick up some people.
entries.translation: 去找军需官，招募一些人手。

entries.source: Leandra Vizcaino is long gone. Nothing left to do but return to the Governor and report your failure.
entries.translation: 莱安德拉·维斯卡伊诺早已离开。你只能回去向总督报告失败。

entries.source: Investigate the north-eastern peninsula for signs of a rebel encampment.
entries.translation: 前往东北部半岛，调查叛军营地的踪迹。

entries.source: Bishop Fray García Padilla of Santo Domingo has fallen very ill. Caro the monk suggests that a doctor named Pedro Bermudez might know the proper treatment, but he has left to treat a new outbreak of the pox in a fishing village on the north coast. You have been asked to go and find Bermudez there.
entries.translation: 圣多明各的加西亚·帕迪利亚修士主教病得很重。卡罗修士认为，名叫佩德罗·贝尔穆德斯的医生或许知道合适的治疗方法，但他已经前往北海岸的一座渔村，救治当地新一轮天花疫情。你受托前往那里寻找贝尔穆德斯。

entries.source: The monks of Santo Domingo have entrusted you with a shipment of bibles to San Tiago. Remember to drop them off next time you're near that town.
entries.translation: 圣多明各的修士们托您将一批圣经送往圣地亚哥。记得下次路过那座城镇时把它们交付出去。

entries.source: Sergeant Luisa Chocero was sent on a patrol into the mountains north-west of Santo Domingo, but her detachment is long overdue to return. Find out what has become of them.
entries.translation: 中士路易莎·乔塞罗被派往圣多明各西北方的山里执行巡逻任务，但她的小队早该返回了。查明他们的下落。

entries.source: Go to the palace at the north end of Santo Domingo and speak to the Governor.
entries.translation: 前往圣多明各北端的宫殿，与总督交谈。

entries.source: Leandra is dead. Regroup with Noriega back in the marketplace.
entries.translation: 莱安德拉已经死了。回到集市与诺列加会合。

entries.source: Leandra has defeated you and Juan Noriega is dead. Regroup with your troops back in the marketplace.
entries.translation: 莱安德拉击败了你，胡安·诺列加也已身亡。带领部队回到集市重新集结。

entries.source: The Hungarian mercenary is a powerfully built man who looks particularly imposing in his black piecemeal armour. He was trained in Hungary's Black Army and fought against the Turks as well as a peasant rebellion. After the dissolution of the Fekete sereg, his company struck out on their own and he travelled to Italy to fight as a mercenary. Now he has come to the New World searching for his old friend, Tamás Szász.
entries.translation: 这名匈牙利雇佣兵身材魁梧，穿着一身黑色拼凑护甲，显得格外威风。他曾在匈牙利黑军受训，也曾与土耳其人作战，并镇压过一场农民叛乱。黑军解散后，他所在的佣兵队自立门户；他则前往意大利，以雇佣兵身份作战。如今，他来到新大陆，寻找旧友塔马什·萨斯。

entries.source: Atl is the healer of a small fishing village on the north coast of Hispaniola. He possesses a biting sarcastic wit which he likes to exercise whenever possible. Despite his reservations towards the Spanish, he is compelled to aid anyone in need, regardless of their ethnicity.
entries.translation: 阿特尔是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛北海岸一座小渔村的治疗师。他言辞尖刻、颇具讽刺意味，而且总喜欢逮着机会挖苦人。尽管他对西班牙人心存戒备，却总是忍不住援助有需要的人，不论对方属于什么族群。

entries.source: Atl has agreed to travel with you back to Santo Domingo to aid in treating the bishop. Return to the cathedral with the remedy.
entries.translation: 阿特尔同意跟你回圣多明各，协助治疗主教。带着药剂返回大教堂。

entries.source: Instead of bringing back the remedy, Atl has agreed to travel with you back to Santo Domingo to aid in treating the bishop.
entries.translation: 阿特尔没有带回药剂，而是同意跟你回圣多明各，协助治疗主教。

entries.source: Atl has instructed you to wrap Orocobix's mushroom powder in leaves and make the bishop ingest it in one portion. Return to the cathedral with the remedy.
entries.translation: 阿特尔吩咐你把奥罗科比克斯的蘑菇粉用叶子包起来，让主教一次服下。带着药剂返回大教堂。

entries.source: Return to the cathedral and report your failure.
entries.translation: 返回大教堂，报告任务失败。

entries.source: Pedro Bermudez has been killed following an encounter with the shaman Orocobix. The shaman may hold the key to curing Bishop Padilla. Find his hut a day's travel southwest of the fishing village.
entries.translation: 佩德罗·贝尔穆德斯在与萨满奥罗科比克斯遭遇后丧命。萨满或许掌握着治愈帕迪利亚主教的关键。去渔村西南方、约一天路程处寻找他的小屋。

entries.source: Follow the coast east to find the savages who attacked and murdered Spanish boats.
entries.translation: 沿海岸向东追踪，找到袭击并杀害西班牙船只上人们的野蛮人。

entries.source: Convince the quartermaster of your worth.
entries.translation: 说服军需官认可你的能力。

entries.source: Return to the Governor at the palace and receive your first official assignment.
entries.translation: 回到宫殿向总督复命，接受你的第一项正式任务。

entries.source: You've found Luisa's corpse with the rest of her detachment in the mountains. Bring her medallion back to her husband Marin in Santo Domingo with the tragic news.
entries.translation: 你在山中发现了路易莎和她分队其他成员的尸体。将她的纪念吊坠带回圣多明各，交给她的丈夫马林，并告知他这个噩耗。

entries.source: You've found a silver locket on a dead soldier from one of Noriega's detachments. Inside is the picture of a man.
entries.translation: 你在诺列加一支分队的阵亡士兵身上找到一枚白银吊坠，里面是一名男子的画像。

entries.source: You had to leave the mad shaman empty-handed. Return to Atl and find out if there's anything else he can do.
entries.translation: 你只得空手离开那位疯狂萨满。回到阿特尔那里，看看他是否还能做些什么。

entries.source: You've got the fungal spores that you came for. Return to Atl in the fishing village and find out what he can do with them.
entries.translation: 你已经拿到了此行要找的真菌孢子。回渔村去找阿特尔，看看他能用这些孢子做些什么。

entries.source: Return to Santo Domingo and inform the Governor of your progress.
entries.translation: 返回圣多明各，向总督汇报你的进展。

entries.source: Return to Santo Domingo and inform the Governor of your failure.
entries.translation: 返回圣多明各，向总督报告你的失败。

entries.source: Esteban came to Hispaniola at the age of 23. He was drafted into the army and served uneasily under Capitán Noriega for two years. When he was fed up, he deserted and lived by himself in the jungle for almost a decade. Eventually he joined a band of fellow deserters under the secret command of Leandra Vizcaino, but he soon took charge of the troops, and they became far more loyal to him. Fearing a power-struggle, Leandra ambushed his troops, driving Esteban to seek an alliance with the savage Caribs. There, you found him again, defeated him one last time, and convinced him to join you.
entries.translation: 埃斯特班23岁时来到了伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。他被征召入伍，在诺列加上尉麾下服役了两年，日子并不好过。终于忍无可忍后，他当了逃兵，独自在丛林中生活了近十年。后来，他加入了一伙同样当过逃兵的人；这伙人暗中听命于莱安德拉·维斯卡伊诺。但不久后，他便接管了这支队伍，众人也对他忠心了许多。莱安德拉担心权力之争，于是伏击了他的部队，逼得埃斯特班转而寻求与野蛮的加勒比人结盟。你在那里再次找到他，最后一次击败了他，并说服他加入你的队伍。

entries.source: Leandra has sent a group of marauders to attack the village in Higuey. It might not be too late to stop them, if you're so inclined.
entries.translation: 莱安德拉派了一伙劫掠者去攻击伊圭村庄。如果你愿意，现在或许还来得及阻止他们。

entries.source: According to Esteban, Leandra is going to attack Santo Domingo with all her remaining troops. Noriega is going to need your help to defend the town.
entries.translation: 据埃斯特班所说，莱安德拉将率领所有剩余部队攻击圣多明各。诺列加需要你的帮助来保卫城镇。

entries.source: Samana was a trap. Leandra set you up. Return to San Tiago and confront her.
entries.translation: 萨马纳是个圈套。莱安德拉设局陷害了你。返回圣地亚哥，找她当面对质。

entries.source: Report back to the Governor of Santo Domingo to let him know the cult won't trouble the town any longer.
entries.translation: 回去向圣多明各总督报告，告诉他教派以后不会再骚扰城镇了。

entries.source: Report back to the Governor of Santo Domingo to inform him of your defeat.
entries.translation: 回去向圣多明各总督报告你们战败的消息。

entries.source: Report back to the Governor of Santo Domingo to let him know that the cult will remain in the ruins for about a week.
entries.translation: 回去向圣多明各总督报告，让他知道这个教派还会在遗迹里停留约一周。

entries.source: Return to San Tiago and inform Leandra that Samana has no trace of the rebels.
entries.translation: 返回圣地亚哥，告诉莱安德拉萨马纳没有叛军的踪迹。

entries.source: The daughter of Andres de Yruenes, who was a part of Columbus' crew. Isabela's mother was a Taíno woman, and as a child of two worlds, Isabela has never found it easy to fit in. Despite her difficulties in gaining the trust of her mother's tribesmen, and the often terrible treatment she sustained from the colonists in Santo Domingo, Isabela has stubbornly held on to a positive outlook on life. She is far from naive, having seen many of the worst sides of people, but she is a stoically polite and open-minded woman who fights for peace and reconciliation for both her peoples.
entries.translation: 哥伦布船员之一安德烈斯·德·尤鲁埃内斯之女。伊莎贝拉的母亲是一位泰诺人。作为两个世界的孩子，伊莎贝拉始终难以融入其中。尽管她难以取得母亲族人的信任，也常遭圣多明各殖民者恶劣对待，她仍顽强地保持着乐观的人生态度。她绝非天真无知，早已见识过人性最恶劣的一面；但她是一位沉着、礼貌、思想开放的女性，为两个族群的和平与和解而奋斗。

entries.source: The town is all but lost, but Leandra has been seen directing her troops near the docks. If you can catch her there and kill her, there is hope that the rebels will simply disperse when their mayhem is complete.
entries.translation: 镇子几乎已经沦陷，但有人发现莱安德拉正在码头附近指挥部队。若能在那里抓住她并杀了她，等叛军肆虐完毕，他们或许就会自行散去。

entries.source: Leandra has been spotted among the rebels that have been pushed back to the docks. Confront her there and bring this rebellion to its conclusion.
entries.translation: 莱安德拉已被发现身在被赶回码头的叛军之中。去那里与她对峙，了结这场叛乱。

entries.source: Proud, fierce, and gorgeous Citlalli was the unofficial leader of a small group of women who participated in the defence of the Aztec city of Tenochtitlan. When the high priest Momoztli cast his affections on her, she rejected him and suffered his wrath in return. Denied the right to serve her city, and faced with losing her sisters, she chose exile and her sisters followed her. Now officially the War Chief of the warrior women, she used advanced and cunning tactics to lead her new tribe to prosperity despite her powerful enemies.
entries.translation: 自豪、勇猛而美丽的西特拉利曾是一个小群体中非正式的领袖。这群女性曾参与阿兹特克人特诺奇蒂特兰城的防御。大祭司莫莫兹特利倾心于她时，她拒绝了他，随即遭到了他的怒火报复。她被剥夺了为城邦效力的权利，又面临失去姐妹们的境地，于是选择流亡；她的姐妹们也追随她而去。如今，她正式成为女战士们的战酋，凭借高超而狡黠的战术，带领新部族走向兴盛，尽管强敌环伺。

entries.source: Return to Momoztli in the Tenochtitlan temple district with Citlalli's talisman.
entries.translation: 带着西特拉利的护符，回到特诺奇蒂特兰神殿区找莫莫兹特利。

entries.source: Tell Momoztli you've killed Citlalli, then murder him and bring his headpiece back to her.
entries.translation: 告诉莫莫兹特利你已经杀了西特拉利，然后杀掉他，把他的头饰带回来交给她。

entries.source: Return to Momoztli in the Tenochtitlan temple district and inform him of your failure.
entries.translation: 回到特诺奇蒂特兰神殿区的莫莫兹特利那里，告诉他你失败了。

entries.source: Return to Xalapa and inform Tepictoton that Tenochtitlan will be receiving no supplies from the northern farms any longer.
entries.translation: 返回哈拉帕，告知特皮克托顿，特诺奇蒂特兰今后再也收不到北方农田送来的补给。

entries.source: Follow the river south-west to locate the depot used by Gutiérrez's expedition.
entries.translation: 沿河向西南行进，寻找古铁雷斯远征队使用的补给站。

entries.source: The Totonac invaders have captured Tenochtitlan's military quarter. You need to go and take it back.
entries.translation: 托托纳克入侵者已经占领特诺奇蒂特兰的军事区。你得去把它夺回来。

entries.source: Tlaxcalteca warriors have captured Tenochtitlan's market. You need to go and take it back.
entries.translation: 特拉斯卡拉人的战士已经占领了特诺奇蒂特兰的集市。你得去把它夺回来。

entries.source: Go to Moctezuma's palace and clear the way for the Totonac invasion force.
entries.translation: 前往蒙特苏马的宫殿，为托托纳克人的入侵部队扫清道路。
夺取特诺奇蒂特兰集市

entries.source: The Tlaxcalteca have fortified themselves in Tenochtitlan's market, you must go there and uproot them.
entries.translation: 特拉斯卡拉人在特诺奇蒂特兰的集市筑起了防线，你必须前往那里将他们赶出去。

entries.source: Follow the path to the west out of Cuautitlán. Turn south at the cairn and follow the ruins until you reach an arrangement of stones.
entries.translation: 沿着小路向西离开夸乌蒂特兰。在石堆路标处向南转，沿遗迹前行，直到找到一处石阵。

entries.source: Return to the palace in Tenochtitlan and inform Quappiatl that Cuautitlán has no food to give.
entries.translation: 回到特诺奇蒂特兰的宫殿，告诉夸皮亚特尔夸乌蒂特兰没有食物可交。

entries.source: Cuautitlán belongs to the Totonac, and will be a valuable area from which to launch the attack on Tenochtitlan. Return to Xalapa and report your success to Tepictoton.
entries.translation: 夸乌蒂特兰属于托托纳克人，是发动对特诺奇蒂特兰攻击的绝佳据点。返回哈拉帕，向特皮克托顿报告胜利。

entries.source: Bring the food from Cuautitlán back to the palace in Tenochtitlan and inform Quappiatl of the service that you've done the Aztec Empire.
entries.translation: 把夸乌蒂特兰的食物带回特诺奇蒂特兰的宫殿，并告知夸皮亚特尔你为阿兹特克帝国立下的功劳。

entries.source: Bring the rotting corpse with the spotted disease back to the shaman Patli in Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 把这具患有斑疹疾病的腐烂尸体带回特诺奇蒂特兰，交给萨满帕特利。

entries.source: Bring the infected villager Iccauhtli back to the shaman Patli in Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 把染病的村民伊考特利带回特诺奇蒂特兰，交给萨满帕特利。

entries.source: Bring the infected corpse of Iccauhtli back to the shaman Patli in Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 把伊考特利染病的尸体带回特诺奇蒂特兰，交给萨满帕特利。

entries.source: Meet the enemies sent to attack your fortress whenever you are ready to face them.
entries.translation: 准备好迎战时，就去会会那些奉命来攻打你堡垒的敌人。

entries.source: The grizzled and sardonic Coyotl was a distinguished Eagle Warrior of the Aztec until he angered the nobles of Tenochtitlan. Unhappy with their apathy towards the suffering of the commoners, he took matters into his own hands and went against their explicit orders. In doing so, he lost command of his warriors and was forced to leave the city of Texcoco where he had been stationed. Instead, he joined your expedition.
entries.translation: 饱经风霜、言辞尖刻的科约特尔曾是阿兹特克人中杰出的鹰战士，直到他惹恼了特诺奇蒂特兰的贵族。他不满他们对平民苦难漠不关心，便亲自采取行动，违抗了他们的明确命令。此举让他失去了对麾下战士的指挥权，也被迫离开驻扎之地特斯科科城。后来，他加入了你的远征队。

entries.source: Having rebuilt Gutiérrez's fortress, you may now return to Quappiatl in Tenochtitlan and meet with Moctezuma again.
entries.translation: 既然已经重建了古铁雷斯的堡垒，你现在可以回到特诺奇蒂特兰找夸皮亚特尔，再次与蒙特苏马会面。

entries.source: Fortaleza De Gutiérrez is restored to its former glory. Return to Xalapa and speak to Tepictoton.
entries.translation: 古铁雷斯要塞已恢复往日荣光。返回哈拉帕，与特皮克托顿交谈。

entries.source: It will take 10 days to finish rebuilding Fortaleza De Gutiérrez.
entries.translation: 重建古铁雷斯要塞需要10天。

entries.source: Assign a member of your expedition to rebuild Fortaleza De Gutiérrez.
entries.translation: 指派一名远征队成员重建古铁雷斯要塞。

entries.source: Necalli means "battle" in the language of the natives, and true to his name, he is without a doubt one of the finest warriors of any of the Totonac tribes. Necalli has been a warrior from the day he was born, raised to protect the village and his fellow tribesmen from the greed of the Aztec. When the tales of your campaign against the Aztecs spread to his home, he was quick to leave his village and seek you out.
entries.translation: 内卡利在原住民语言中意为"战斗"。他确实名副其实，毫无疑问是托托纳克部族中最出色的战士之一。内卡利自出生起便是战士，从小被培养着保护村庄和族人免受阿兹特克人的贪欲侵害。当你对抗阿兹特克人的战事传到他家乡后，他很快便离开村庄，前来寻找你。

entries.source: The Totonac assault on Fortaleza De Gutierrez has been repelled. Return to Quappiatl and Moctezuma and aid them in the defence of Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 托托纳克人对古铁雷斯要塞的攻击已被击退。回到夸皮亚特尔和蒙特苏马身边，协助他们防御特诺奇蒂特兰。

entries.source: The Aztec assault on Fortaleza De Gutierrez has been repelled. Return to Tepictoton and participate in the assault of Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 阿兹特克人对古铁雷斯要塞的进攻已被击退。回到特皮克托顿身边，参与进攻特诺奇蒂特兰。

entries.source: You have lost Fortaleza De Gutiérrez! Return to Tenochtitlan and consult Quappiatl about the strategic implications of your defeat.
entries.translation: 你已失去古铁雷斯要塞！返回特诺奇蒂特兰，向夸皮亚特尔询问这场败仗对战略局势的影响。

entries.source: You have lost Fortaleza De Gutiérrez! Return to Tepictoton and consult him about the strategic implications of your defeat.
entries.translation: 你已失去古铁雷斯要塞！返回特皮克托顿身边，向他询问这场败仗对战略局势的影响。

entries.source: Investigate the Masaya volcano, which according to tribal folklore hides a portal to the underworld.
entries.translation: 调查马萨亚火山。据部族民的传说，那里藏着一座通往冥界的门户。

entries.source: Tutul Xiu, chieftain of the village of Masaya, has asked you to track down and kill a group of Mayan bandits south of the village.
entries.translation: 马萨亚村庄的酋长图图尔·修请求你前往村庄南边，追踪并杀死一伙玛雅强盗。

entries.source: Find the Aztec patrol charged with collecting taxes from the Totonac and kill them.
entries.translation: 找到负责向托托纳克人收税的阿兹特克巡逻队，并杀掉他们。

entries.source: Return to Quappiatl in the Tenochtitlan Palace and inform him that you have razed Papantla.
entries.translation: 回到特诺奇蒂特兰宫殿找夸皮亚特尔，告诉他你已夷平帕潘特拉。

entries.source: Your attempt to take Papantla failed, but the town is going nowhere. You can't return to Quappiatl until you've razed the city.
entries.translation: 你攻占帕潘特拉的尝试失败了，但那座城又不会长腿跑掉。在你夷平这座城之前，无法返回夸皮亚特尔。

entries.source: Bring 25 Herbs to the spring that supplies Papantla with water, so you can poison it, weakening the settlement's defences.
entries.translation: 带25份草药到为帕潘特拉供水的泉水边，以便给泉水下毒，削弱定居点的防御。

entries.source: Your loving wife, who you married in a small village where her father ruled a wealthy tribe of pearl fishers. Tayanna exhibits many traits often found in those who have been priviledged with a safe and largely care-free existence, and her optimism and charisma makes her light up like a beacon in your expedition.
entries.translation: 你深爱的妻子。你们在一个小村庄结了婚，她的父亲统治着一个富庶的采珠人部族。塔娅娜身上有许多特质，常见于那些有幸过着安全、无忧生活的人；她乐观开朗，魅力十足，在你的远征队中如灯塔般耀眼。

entries.source: Your loving husband, who you married in a small village where his father ruled a wealthy tribe of pearl fishers. Cacama has a tender and considerate disposition, in stark contrast to most of the men in your life. He is consistently open-minded and addresses every problem with an energy and enthusiasm that puts everyone else in your expedition to shame.
entries.translation: 你深爱的丈夫。你们是在一个小村庄成婚的，他的父亲统治着一个富庶的采珠人部族。卡卡马性情温柔体贴，与你生命中的大多数男人截然不同。他始终思想开放，面对任何问题都充满干劲和热情，让远征队里的其他人相形见绌。

entries.source: Miguel Sicart is one of the few survivors of Felipe Gutiérrez's expedition that you've encountered on the mainland. You found him in a small hut that he'd built himself, and after a little adventure with a poisonous frog paella, you convinced him to join your expedition. Annoyingly he continues to evade all questions about Gutiérrez, but wastes no opportunity to call your predecessor a fool.
entries.translation: 米格尔·西卡特是你在美洲大陆遇到的、费利佩·古铁雷斯远征队少数幸存者之一。你在一间他亲手搭建的小屋里找到了他。经历了一场毒蛙肉西班牙烩饭的小小冒险后，你说服他加入了你的远征队。令人恼火的是，他仍然回避所有关于古铁雷斯的问题，却总能抓住机会骂你的前任是个蠢货。

entries.source: Go to the military quarter and see how the fight went there.
entries.translation: 前往军事区，看看那里的战况。

entries.source: Go to the palace and see how the fight went there.
entries.translation: 前往宫殿，看看那里的战况。

entries.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
entries.translation: 准备好回国向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历时，就返回你的船只，扬帆启航。

entries.source: Return to Texcoco and deliver the stolen sacks to Coyotl.
entries.translation: 返回特斯科科，把偷来的货袋交给科约特尔。

entries.source: Return to Texcoco and report your failure to Coyotl.
entries.translation: 返回特斯科科，向科约特尔报告失败。

entries.source: A merchant in Tenochtitlan has asked you to find the Eagle Warrior Coyotl and make him cease his threats. Coyotl is stationed in Texcoco, on the eastern bank of the lake.
entries.translation: 一名特诺奇蒂特兰的商人请你找到鹰战士科约特尔，让他停止威胁。科约特尔驻扎在湖东岸的特斯科科。

entries.source: Go the market and see how the war is progressing.
The Imperial palace is under attack! Return there immediately and save the Emperor.
entries.translation: 皇宫正遭受攻击！立刻返回那里，救下皇帝。

entries.source: Return to the imperial palace in Tenochtitlan at your convenience and participate in the feast that Tepictoton is throwing in your honour.
entries.translation: 你方便时可以回到特诺奇蒂特兰的皇宫，参加特皮克托顿为你举办的盛宴。

entries.source: Meet Juan Noriega in Templo Mayor in Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 在特诺奇蒂特兰的大神庙与胡安·诺列加会面。

entries.source: Regroup in Templo Mayor in Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 在特诺奇蒂特兰的大神庙集合。

entries.source: Go to the market and see how the fight went there.
entries.translation: 去市场看看那里的战况。

entries.source: Return to Moctezuma's palace and slay the Emperor in the garden where he is holed up with his guards.
entries.translation: 回到蒙特苏马的宫殿，在花园里杀死躲藏起来、由卫兵守护的皇帝。

entries.source: Return to the imperial palace in Tenochtitlan at your convenience and participate in the feast that Moctezuma is throwing in your honour.
entries.translation: 方便时回到特诺奇蒂特兰的皇宫，参加蒙特苏马为你设下的盛宴。

entries.source: Take your troops to the main Causeway into Tenochtitlan and provoke the Totonac army to attack.
entries.translation: 率领你的部队前往通往特诺奇蒂特兰的主堤道，挑衅托托纳克人军队发动攻击。

entries.source: Return to your fortress and prepare your people to defend against an attack by the Totonac rebels.
entries.translation: 返回你的堡垒，准备好人手，防御托托纳克人叛军的攻击。

entries.source: Rebuild the Spanish fortress north-west of Tenochtitlan and return to the palace to speak to Moctezuma when the reconstruction is complete.
entries.translation: 重建特诺奇蒂特兰西北方的西班牙人的堡垒，完工后返回宫殿与蒙特苏马交谈。

entries.source: Travel to Xalapa to the north and decide how to deal with Tepictoton and his budding Totonac insurrection. Quappiatl has sent a division of warriors to help you in the event of a battle.
entries.translation: 前往北方的哈拉帕，决定如何处置特皮克托顿及其正在酝酿的托托纳克人叛乱。如有战斗，夸皮亚特尔已派出一支战士队伍前来助你。

entries.source: The Aztec have asked you to neutralise the town of Papantla in preparation for war with the Totonac.
entries.translation: 阿兹特克人要求你攻占帕潘特拉镇，为与托托纳克人的战争做准备。

entries.source: Travel to the Toltec Temple east of Tenochtitlan and interrupt the secret meeting between Tlaxcala representatives and Aztec nobles.
entries.translation: 前往特诺奇蒂特兰以东的托尔特克神庙，打断特拉斯卡拉代表与阿兹特克贵族之间的秘密会面。

entries.source: To curry favour with the Aztec Empire, travel to Cuautitlán and get them to relinquish the food they owe Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 为了赢得阿兹特克帝国的好感，前往夸乌蒂特兰，让他们交出欠特诺奇蒂特兰的粮食。

entries.source: Return to the palace and participate in Tepictoton's feast in your honour.
entries.translation: 回到宫殿，参加特皮克托顿为你设下的宴席。

entries.source: Return to the palace and participate in Moctezuma's feast in your honour.
entries.translation: 回到宫殿，参加蒙特苏马为你举办的宴席。

entries.source: Bring Momoztli's headpiece back to Citlalli.
entries.translation: 把莫莫兹特利的头饰带回去交给西特拉利。

entries.source: Return to Citlalli with news of your failure.
entries.translation: 带着失败的消息回去找西特拉利。

entries.source: Kill Citlalli, the war chief of the warrior women west of Tenochtitlan, and return to Momoztli with her talisman.
entries.translation: 杀死特诺奇蒂特兰以西女战士的战酋西特拉利，再带着她的护符回来见莫莫兹特利。

entries.source: Steal 60 bags of corn and seeds from Mātlal's warehouse in the market of Tenochtitlan and bring them back to Coyotl.
entries.translation: 从特诺奇蒂特兰集市里马特拉尔的仓库偷走60袋玉米与种子，带回给科约特尔。

entries.source: You've promised Coyotl that you'll bring him 300 Rations so he can help the starving people around Texcoco.
entries.translation: 你答应过科约特尔，会带来300份口粮，帮助特斯科科一带挨饿的百姓。

entries.source: You ended up giving Coyotl the rations he needed out of your own stores, and you got his shield in return. Go back to the market in Tenochtitlan and give Mātlal the shield.
entries.translation: 你最终从自己的库存中拿出口粮给了科约特尔，换回他的盾牌。回到特诺奇蒂特兰集市，把盾牌交给马特拉尔。

entries.source: Coyotl is dead. Return to the market in Tenochtitlan and show his shield to Mātlal.
entries.translation: 科约特尔死了。回到特诺奇蒂特兰集市，把他的盾牌拿给马特拉尔看。

entries.source: Patli is a bit of a mystery to you. As an Aztec healer from the city of Tenochtitlan, he is a skilled and experienced healer, but he speaks not a word of Spanish and largely keeps to himself during your travels, and most of your people seem perfectly happy with that. When you do interact with him through your interpreters, he is friendly, accomodating, and surprisingly funny.
entries.translation: 帕特利对你来说有些神秘。他是来自特诺奇蒂特兰的阿兹特克治疗师，医术娴熟，经验丰富；但他一句西班牙语也不会说，旅途中也大多独来独往，而你的人似乎对此都很满意。你通过翻译与他交谈时，会发现他友善、随和，而且出奇地风趣。

entries.source: Travel to the town of Cuautitlán and bring back a corpse for Patli.
entries.translation: 前往夸乌蒂特兰镇，为帕特利带回一具尸体。

entries.source: Travel to the town to the north west of Tenochtitlan and bring back one of the afflicted for Patli.
entries.translation: 前往特诺奇蒂特兰西北方的城镇，为帕特利带回一名患者。

entries.source: You have retrieved the idol that Tepictoton wanted. Return to Xalapa and give it back to him.
entries.translation: 你已经找到了特皮克托顿想要的神像。回到哈拉帕，把它还给他。

entries.source: Bring Cihuātōn back to Xalapa and inform Tepictoton that the meeting was a success.
entries.translation: 带西瓦顿回哈拉帕，告诉特皮克托顿会面很成功。

entries.source: Return to Xalapa and inform Tepictoton of the catastrophic outcome of the meeting.
entries.translation: 回到哈拉帕，告知特皮克托顿会面惨败。

entries.source: Return to Quappiatl at the palace in Tenochtitlan and report on your success.
entries.translation: 回到特诺奇蒂特兰宫殿里的夸皮亚特尔处，向他报告成功的消息。

entries.source: Return to Quappiatl at the palace in Tenochtitlan and report on your failure.
entries.translation: 回到特诺奇蒂特兰宫殿里的夸皮亚特尔处，报告失败的消息。

entries.source: Tlālli is making off with the idol that you need to bring back to Tepictoton. Catch him and get the idol from him.
entries.translation: 特拉利正带着你要送回特皮克托顿的神像逃走。抓住他，把神像夺回来。

entries.source: North of the Totonac village stands a marker made of stones and spears. Turn west from there and continue until you reach a small pond at the base of a cliff, where you will find the idol for Tepictoton.
entries.translation: 托托纳克村庄以北有一座由石块和长矛搭成的标记。从那里向西走，直到抵达悬崖脚下的一处小池塘，你会在那里找到献给特皮克托顿的神像。

entries.source: The daughter of the Totonac chief Tepictoton, Anacaona is a friendly and adventurous and somewhat hyperactive young girl burdened with a priviledged but bored upbringing. As the daughter of a local chieftain, she is a considerable diplomatic asset, and it helps that her Spanish is impeccable.
entries.translation: 阿纳卡奥娜是托托纳克人酋长特皮克托顿的女儿。她待人友善、爱冒险，还有些过分活泼；优渥却乏味的成长环境让这个年轻女孩颇感烦闷。身为当地酋长的女儿，她是极有价值的外交筹码，而且她的西班牙语说得无可挑剔。

entries.source: Rendezvous with Tepictoton's army north of Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 与特皮克托顿的军队在特诺奇蒂特兰北面会合。

entries.source: Return to your fortress and prepare your people to defend against an attack by the Aztec Empire.
entries.translation: 回到你的堡垒，让你的人做好防御准备，抵挡阿兹特克帝国的攻击。

entries.source: Bring 5000 Valuables to Tepictoton in Xalapa if you wish to proceed with your plans to make war on the Aztecs.
entries.translation: 如果你想继续谋划对阿兹特克人的战争，就把5000点贵重物品送到哈拉帕的特皮克托顿那里。

entries.source: Rebuild the Spanish fortress west of Xalapa and return to Tepictoton when the reconstruction is complete.
entries.translation: 重建哈拉帕以西的西班牙人的堡垒，完工后回来找特皮克托顿。

entries.source: Travel to the Aztec settlement of Cuautitlán and raze it in preparation for a full-scale assault on Tenochtitlan. Tepictoton has sent a contingent of his warriors there to help you.
entries.translation: 前往阿兹特克人的夸乌蒂特兰定居点，将其焚毁，为全面进攻特诺奇蒂特兰做准备。特皮克托顿已派出一队战士前去协助你。

entries.source: Attack and raze the Aztec farms north of Tenochtitlan.
entries.translation: 攻击并烧毁特诺奇蒂特兰以北的阿兹特克农田。

entries.source: Bring Cihuātōn to the Tlaxcalan tomb and watch over her diplomatic meeting with the envoy from Tlaxcala.
entries.translation: 带西瓦顿前往特拉斯卡拉墓穴，监督她与特拉斯卡拉使者的外交会谈。

entries.source: In exchange for the safe return of his daughter, Tepictoton has sworn to keep Xalapa out of the Totonac attack on Tenochtitlan, though he can't stop the attack altogether. Return to Moctezuma to report the outcome of your mission.
entries.translation: 作为女儿平安归来的交换，特皮克托顿发誓会让哈拉帕不参与托托纳克人对特诺奇蒂特兰的攻击，尽管他无法彻底阻止这场攻击。回去向蒙特苏马报告任务结果。

entries.source: You have led a division of Aztec warriors in the conquest of the Totonac capital Xalapa. Return to Tenochtitlan and report your success to Moctezuma.
entries.translation: 你率领一支阿兹特克武士部队征服了托托纳克人的都城哈拉帕。返回特诺奇蒂特兰，向蒙特苏马禀报胜利。

entries.source: Travel to the village north west of Xalapa and reclaim the idol their chief took from Tepictoton's father many years ago.
entries.translation: 前往哈拉帕西北方的村庄，取回多年前该村酋长从特皮克托顿父亲手中夺走的神像。

entries.source: You have killed the Aztec warriors as Calliandra requested. Return to Papantla and show her the trinkets you took from the bodies.
entries.translation: 你已按卡莉安德拉的要求杀死了阿兹特克武士。返回帕潘特拉，把从尸体上拿到的小饰品交给她。

entries.source: Return to Tutul Xiu in the village of Masaya and inform him that the bandits will no longer pose a threat.
entries.translation: 回到马萨亚村庄向图图尔·修报信，告诉他强盗不会再构成威胁。

entries.source: Fortaleza De Gutiérrez ought to be fully rebuilt by now. Return to the fortress to inspect the result.
entries.translation: 古铁雷斯要塞如今应该已经全部重建完毕。返回堡垒查看成果。

entries.source: The barracks of Fortaleza De Gutiérrez should be finished by now. Return to the fortress to inspect them.
entries.translation: 古铁雷斯要塞的兵营现在应该已经完工。返回堡垒查看一番。

entries.source: Your workers should now be done refurbishing the storerooms of Fortaleza De Gutiérrez. Return to the fortress at your leisure.
entries.translation: 工人现在应该已经完成了古铁雷斯要塞储藏室的翻修。你方便时再返回堡垒即可。

entries.source: The chapel of Fortaleza De Gutiérrez must have been completely rebuilt now. Return to the fortress to visit it.
entries.translation: 古铁雷斯要塞的礼拜堂现在想必已经彻底重建完毕。返回堡垒看看吧。

entries.source: The new tavern for Fortaleza De Gutiérrez should be finished by now. Return to the fortress to visit it.
entries.translation: 古铁雷斯要塞的新酒馆现在应该已经完工。返回堡垒看看吧。

entries.source: Your new trading post in Fortaleza De Gutiérrez must be open for business now. Return to the fortress when it suits you.
entries.translation: 你在古铁雷斯要塞新建的贸易站现在应该已经开张营业了。方便时就回堡垒看看吧。

entries.source: The workshop in Fortaleza De Gutiérrez should be finished by now. Return to the fortress to inspect it.
entries.translation: 古铁雷斯要塞的工坊现在应该已经完工了。回堡垒检查一下吧。

entries.source: The new stable for Fortaleza De Gutiérrez must be ready now. Return to the fortress to see how it turned out.
entries.translation: 古铁雷斯要塞的新马厩现在应该已经准备就绪。回堡垒看看建得如何吧。

entries.source: Esteban has absconded with FNameFirst1. FNameFirst3 thinks he must be taking FHimHer1 to be sacrificed by the savage Caribs that live in the mountains near the coast to the north west. You probably have until the next full moon to prevent this.
entries.translation: 埃斯特班带着FNameFirst1逃走了。FNameFirst3认为，他一定是要把FHimHer1交给住在西北方海岸附近山里的凶残加勒比人，供他们献祭。你大概还有时间赶在下次满月前阻止这一切。
